```{r}
  if (nrow(pairs_vis) == 0L) stop("No renderable temporal pairs.")

  cat(sprintf("Rendering %d temporal pair(s) x %d threshold(s).\n",
              nrow(pairs_vis), length(thr_keys)))

  # ── Row matching ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  get_slice_row <- function(raw_list, tid, target_dz) {
    df <- raw_list[[as.character(tid)]]
    if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0L) return(NULL)
    base_z <- min(df$slice_z, na.rm = TRUE)
    hit    <- which(abs((df$slice_z - base_z) - target_dz) <= slice_match_eps)
    if (length(hit) != 1L) return(NULL)
    row <- df[hit, ]
    if (is.na(row$center_x)) return(NULL)
    row
  }

  dz_of <- function(df) {
    if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0L) return(numeric(0))
    round(df$slice_z - min(df$slice_z, na.rm = TRUE), 6)
  }

  slice_heights_for <- function(tid_1, tid_2) {
    df1 <- raw_1_ref[[as.character(tid_1)]]
    df2 <- raw_2_ref[[as.character(tid_2)]]
    dz1 <- dz_of(df1); dz2 <- dz_of(df2)
    dz_all <- sort(unique(c(dz1, dz2)))
    if (length(dz_all) == 0L) return(numeric(0))

    fitted_dz <- c(dz1[!is.na(df1$center_x)], dz2[!is.na(df2$center_x)])
    if (length(fitted_dz) == 0L) return(numeric(0))

    dz_all <- dz_all[dz_all <= max(fitted_dz) + slice_match_eps]

    if (!is.null(n_thr_rows)) {
      dz_all <- dz_all[dz_all >= min(fitted_dz) - slice_match_eps]
      if (length(dz_all) > n_thr_rows) dz_all <- dz_all[seq_len(n_thr_rows)]
    }

    dz_all
  }

  las_pts_cache_shared <- list(
    las_1 = as.data.frame(las_1@data[, c("point_id", "X", "Y")]),
    las_2 = as.data.frame(las_2@data[, c("point_id", "X", "Y")])
  )

  # ── Grid builder with a parallel status matrix ─────────────────────────────
  # `status` mirrors `matrix`: "kept" | "consensus" | "mad" | NA (blank cell).
  make_threshold_grid_flagged <- function(s1_threshold_results, las_defs, thr_keys,
                                          slice_heights, get_slice_row,
                                          las_pts_cache = NULL, label_offset = 0) {

    col_specs <- list()
    for (nm in names(las_defs)) {
      for (key in thr_keys) {
        col_specs[[length(col_specs) + 1]] <- list(
          las_name = nm, thr_key = key,
          label = sprintf("%s | thr=%s", nm, key)
        )
      }
    }

    if (is.null(las_pts_cache))
      las_pts_cache <- lapply(las_defs, function(def)
        as.data.frame(def$las_obj@data[, c("point_id", "X", "Y")]))

    panel_matrix  <- vector("list", length(slice_heights))
    status_matrix <- vector("list", length(slice_heights))

    for (r in seq_along(slice_heights)) {
      target_dz <- slice_heights[r]
      row_cells <- vector("list", length(col_specs))
      row_stat  <- vector("list", length(col_specs))

      for (c in seq_along(col_specs)) {
        spec     <- col_specs[[c]]
        def      <- las_defs[[spec$las_name]]
        raw_i    <- s1_threshold_results[[spec$thr_key]][[def$res_field]]$raw
        row_data <- get_slice_row(raw_i, def$treeid, target_dz)

        row_cells[[c]] <- make_threshold_panel(row_data, las_pts_cache[[spec$las_name]])

        if (is.null(row_data)) {
          row_stat[[c]] <- NA_character_
        } else {
          st <- .vis_slice_status(
            raw_i, def$treeid,
            cache_key = paste(spec$las_name, spec$thr_key, def$treeid, sep = "|")
          )
          hit <- which(abs(st$slice_z - row_data$slice_z) <= slice_match_eps)
          row_stat[[c]] <- if (length(hit) == 1L) st$status[hit] else NA_character_
        }
      }
      panel_matrix[[r]]  <- row_cells
      status_matrix[[r]] <- row_stat
    }

    list(
      matrix     = panel_matrix,
      status     = status_matrix,
      row_labels = sprintf("h \u2248 %.3f m", slice_heights + label_offset),
      col_labels = vapply(col_specs, function(s) s$label, character(1))
    )
  }

  # ── Renderer with coloured outlines ────────────────────────────────────────
  render_gallery_grid_flagged <- function(grid_obj, lb_id, w = 3.2, h = 3.2, dpi = 140,
                                          col_consensus = outline_consensus_col,
                                          col_mad       = outline_mad_col,
                                          border_px     = outline_px) {

    panel_matrix  <- grid_obj$matrix
    status_matrix <- grid_obj$status
    row_labels    <- grid_obj$row_labels
    col_labels    <- grid_obj$col_labels
    n_col         <- length(col_labels)

    has_content <- any(vapply(panel_matrix, function(row)
      any(!vapply(row, is.null, logical(1))), logical(1)))
    if (!has_content) return(HTML("<p>No data.</p>"))

    encode_plot <- function(p) {
      if (is.null(p)) return(NA_character_)
      tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")
      on.exit(unlink(tmp), add = TRUE)
      ggsave(tmp, plot = p, width = w, height = h, dpi = dpi, bg = "white")
      paste0("data:image/png;base64,", base64enc::base64encode(tmp))
    }

    border_for <- function(status) {
      col <- switch(as.character(status),
                    "consensus" = col_consensus,
                    "mad"       = col_mad,
                    "transparent")
      sprintf("border:%dpx solid %s;", border_px, col)
    }

    img_tag <- function(src, status) {
      if (is.na(src))
        return('<div style="background:#f4f4f4;border-radius:6px;min-height:120px;"></div>')
      sprintf(
        '<img src="%s"
              style="width:100%%;border-radius:4px;%s
                     box-shadow:0 1px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.18);
                     cursor:zoom-in;display:block;box-sizing:border-box;"
              onclick="openLb_%s(this.src)" />',
        src, border_for(status), lb_id
      )
    }

    header_row <- paste(
      vapply(col_labels, function(lbl)
        sprintf('<div style="font-size:11px;font-weight:600;text-align:center;padding:2px;">%s</div>', lbl),
        character(1)),
      collapse = ""
    )
    header_row <- sprintf(
      '<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:90px repeat(%d,1fr);gap:6px;margin-bottom:4px;"><div></div>%s</div>',
      n_col, header_row
    )

    swatch <- function(col, txt)
      sprintf('<span style="display:inline-block;width:14px;height:14px;border:%dpx solid %s;
                            vertical-align:-3px;margin:0 5px 0 14px;box-sizing:border-box;"></span>%s',
              border_px, col, txt)

    legend <- sprintf(
      '<div style="font-size:12px;margin:0 0 8px 2px;">%s%s%s</div>',
      swatch(col_consensus, "removed by neighbour consensus"),
      swatch(col_mad,       "removed by MAD semi-minor filter"),
      '<span style="margin-left:14px;">no outline = kept</span>')

    body_rows <- paste(
      vapply(seq_along(panel_matrix), function(r) {
        cells <- vapply(panel_matrix[[r]], encode_plot, character(1))
        stats <- status_matrix[[r]]
        imgs  <- paste(vapply(seq_along(cells),
                              function(k) img_tag(cells[k], stats[[k]]),
                              character(1)), collapse = "")
        sprintf(
          '<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:90px repeat(%d,1fr);gap:6px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:6px;">
             <div style="font-size:11px;font-weight:600;">%s</div>%s
           </div>',
          n_col, row_labels[r], imgs
        )
      }, character(1)),
      collapse = "\n"
    )

    HTML(sprintf('
<style>
  #lbOv_%s{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9999;
    background:rgba(0,0,0,.82);align-items:center;justify-content:center;}
  #lbOv_%s.open{display:flex;}
  #lbOv_%s img{max-width:95vw;max-height:95vh;border-radius:6px;
    box-shadow:0 4px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.6);}
  #lbCl_%s{position:fixed;top:16px;right:20px;font-size:32px;color:#fff;
    cursor:pointer;line-height:1;user-select:none;z-index:10000;}
</style>
<div id="lbOv_%s" onclick="if(event.target===this)closeLb_%s()">
  <span id="lbCl_%s" onclick="closeLb_%s()">&#x2715;</span>
  <img id="lbIm_%s" src=""/>
</div>
<div style="padding:10px;overflow-x:auto;">%s%s%s</div>
<script>
  window.openLb_%s  = s => {
    document.getElementById("lbIm_%s").src = s;
    document.getElementById("lbOv_%s").classList.add("open");
  };
  window.closeLb_%s = () =>
    document.getElementById("lbOv_%s").classList.remove("open");
</script>',
      lb_id, lb_id, lb_id, lb_id,
      lb_id, lb_id, lb_id, lb_id, lb_id,
      legend, header_row, body_rows,
      lb_id, lb_id, lb_id, lb_id, lb_id
    ))
  }

  # ── One grid per temporal pair ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  pair_blocks <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(pairs_vis)), function(i) {

    tid_1 <- pairs_vis$TreeID_1[i]
    tid_2 <- pairs_vis$TreeID_2[i]

    las_defs <- list(
      las_1 = list(las_obj = las_1, res_field = "res_1", treeid = tid_1),
      las_2 = list(las_obj = las_2, res_field = "res_2", treeid = tid_2)
    )

    dz <- slice_heights_for(tid_1, tid_2)
    if (length(dz) == 0L) return(NULL)

    grid_obj <- make_threshold_grid_flagged(s1_threshold_results, las_defs, thr_keys,
                                            dz, get_slice_row,
                                            las_pts_cache = las_pts_cache_shared,
                                            label_offset  = slice_label_offset)

    n_of <- function(v) sum(vapply(grid_obj$status,
                                   function(rw) sum(vapply(rw, function(s)
                                     !is.na(s) && s == v, logical(1))),
                                   integer(1)))
    n_panels <- sum(vapply(grid_obj$status,
                           function(rw) sum(!vapply(rw, function(s) is.na(s)[1], logical(1))),
                           integer(1)))

    tagList(
      h3(sprintf("Pair %d of %d \u2014 las_1 TreeID %s \u2194 las_2 TreeID %s \u2014 %d consensus / %d MAD removed of %d panels",
                 i, nrow(pairs_vis), tid_1, tid_2,
                 n_of("consensus"), n_of("mad"), n_panels)),
      render_gallery_grid_flagged(grid_obj, sprintf("thrgrid_%s_%s", tid_1, tid_2))
    )
  })

  browsable(tagList(
    h3("RANSAC threshold sweep \u2014 temporal pairs"),
    h4("Rows = slice-centre height above each stem's own lowest point \u2014 columns = las_1 thresholds \u2192 las_2 thresholds"),
    h4("Red outline = removed by neighbour consensus \u2014 orange = removed by MAD semi-minor filter"),
    pair_blocks
  ))
}
```

## 1.3 Ellipse Refit

```{r}
#| label: params-ransac-ellipse-refit-masked
#| code-summary: "Parameters - Second-pass RANSAC on consensus-removed slices, masked by a circle projected along the local lean from the nearest kept slice"


# ── Parameters ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
run_ellipse_refit <- TRUE

# Which removals get a second attempt.
#   "consensus"     -> only slices dropped by the neighbour-consensus filter
#   "consensus_mad" -> those plus slices dropped by the MAD semi-minor filter
refit_targets <- "consensus"

# ── Mask geometry ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# A circle in the slice plane. Points outside it are invisible to the refit.
#
# CENTRE is NOT the anchor's own centre. The anchor sits at a different height,
# and on a leaning stem the stem has moved lean * dz by the time it reaches the
# target slice - at a 20 deg lean that is ~0.15 m per 0.4 m of rise, further
# than the mask radius itself, so an anchor-centred mask can enclose nothing but
# air. That was the source of the too_few_pts and fit_failed statuses. The
# centre is therefore anchor centre + lean * dz, the lean coming from
# .local_lean() - the SAME predictor the Step 1.2 consensus filter uses, so the
# refit looks for the stem exactly where the filter expects it to be.
#
# RADIUS is three terms, not one:
#     max(anchor semi-major, refit_r_floor_frac * stem median semi-major)
#       * refit_mask_scale
#       + refit_pred_pad_mult * (residual RMS of the lean fit)
# guarding, in order: the stem's actual size, a spuriously tiny anchor ellipse,
# and how far the prediction had to reach.
refit_mask_scale <- 1.5

# Floor on the mask radius as a fraction of this stem's own median semi-major.
refit_r_floor_frac <- 0.75
# Padding for prediction uncertainty, as a multiple of the lean fit's residual
# RMS. Raise it if refit_pred_shift is large and few_pts is still high.
refit_pred_pad_mult <- 2.0

refit_min_pts    <- 5L      # fewer masked points than this -> no attempt
refit_seed       <- 42L     # combined with TreeID and slice index per fit

# Fit settings. NULL = inherit from the Step 1.1 params (fp), so the refit uses
# the same threshold and iteration count as the first pass unless told otherwise.
refit_distance_threshold <- NULL
refit_n_iterations       <- NULL

refit_early_exit         <- FALSE   # off by default: a masked slice is the hard

.par_apply("params-ransac-ellipse-refit-masked")
```

```{r}
#| label: ransac-ellipse-refit-masked
#| code-summary: "Second-pass RANSAC on consensus-removed slices, masked by a circle projected along the local lean from the nearest kept slice"

# Lean prediction for mask placement. Exposed separately from the Step 1.2
# consensus setting so the main pipeline can be tuned independently of Stage 1A,
# but they are intended to match: a filter and a refit that disagree about where
# the stem is will feed each other slices the other has rejected.
refit_use_local_lean <- if (exists("consensus_use_local_lean")) consensus_use_local_lean else TRUE
refit_lean_k         <- if (exists("consensus_lean_k"))         consensus_lean_k         else 4L


# Adaptive iteration budget for the refit. NULL inherits the Step 1.1 setting,
# so by default the refit follows the same rule – but on the MASKED point count,
# which is smaller, so a refit slice gets a smaller budget than its first pass.
refit_iter_per_point <- if (exists("ransac_iter_per_point")) ransac_iter_per_point else 1.5
refit_iter_max       <- if (exists("ransac_iter_max"))       ransac_iter_max       else 750L
refit_iter_min       <- if (exists("ransac_iter_min"))       ransac_iter_min       else 1L

                                    # case, so let it use the full iteration budget

# .refit_one_tree is defined in Section 0.5 (ellipse-pipeline-functions), shared
# with the Stage 1A alignment refit.

# ── Run ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if (run_ellipse_refit) {

  if (!exists("clean_results_1_all") || is.null(clean_results_1_all))
    stop("clean_results_1_all not found – run the ransac-ellipse-clean chunk first.")

  .refit_dist  <- if (is.null(refit_distance_threshold)) fp$distance_threshold else
                    refit_distance_threshold
  .refit_iter  <- if (is.null(refit_n_iterations)) fp$n_iterations else
                    refit_n_iterations
  .refit_width <- fp$width
  .incl_mad    <- identical(refit_targets, "consensus_mad")

  cat(sprintf(
    paste0("Masked refit: targets = %s | mask = %.2f x max(anchor a, %.2f x stem median a)",
           " + %.1f x resid RMS, lean-placed (%s) | threshold = %.4f m | %s\n"),
    refit_targets, refit_mask_scale, refit_r_floor_frac, refit_pred_pad_mult,
    if (isTRUE(refit_use_local_lean)) sprintf("k = %d", refit_lean_k) else "OFF",
    .refit_dist,
    if (is.null(refit_iter_per_point))
      sprintf("%d iterations (fixed)", .refit_iter)
    else
      sprintf("%.1f iterations/point, clamped to [%d, %d]",
              refit_iter_per_point, refit_iter_min, refit_iter_max)))

  .refit_cloud <- function(clean_result, las, label) {
    if (is.null(clean_result) || length(clean_result) == 0L) return(NULL)

    dt <- data.table::as.data.table(las@data)[, .(TreeID, point_id, X, Y, Z)]

    .pb <- .pb_new(length(clean_result), sprintf("%s masked refit", label))
    on.exit(.pb_done(.pb), add = TRUE)

    out <- lapply(names(clean_result), function(tid) {
      .pb_tick(.pb)
      pts_tree <- as.data.frame(dt[TreeID == as.integer(tid)])
      .refit_one_tree(pts_tree, tid, clean_result[[tid]]$flagged,
                      width       = .refit_width,
                      mask_scale  = refit_mask_scale,
                      min_pts     = refit_min_pts,
                      seed        = refit_seed,
                      dist_thr    = .refit_dist,
                      n_iter      = .refit_iter,
                      early_exit  = refit_early_exit,
                      include_mad = .incl_mad,
                      track_hist  = if (exists("ransac_track_history"))
                                      ransac_track_history else TRUE,
                      iter_pp     = refit_iter_per_point,
                      iter_mx     = refit_iter_max,
                      iter_mn     = refit_iter_min,
                      use_local_lean = refit_use_local_lean,
                      lean_k         = refit_lean_k,
                      pred_pad_mult  = refit_pred_pad_mult,
                      r_floor_frac   = refit_r_floor_frac)
    })
    setNames(out, names(clean_result))
  }

  refit_flagged_1 <- .refit_cloud(clean_results_1_all, las_1, "las_1")
  refit_flagged_2 <- .refit_cloud(clean_results_2_all, las_2, "las_2")

  # ── Summary ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  .refit_summary <- function(refit_flagged, label) {
    if (is.null(refit_flagged)) { cat(sprintf("[%s] nothing to refit.\n", label))
                                  return(invisible(NULL)) }
    tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(refit_flagged), function(tid) {
      d <- refit_flagged[[tid]]
      st <- d$refit_status[!is.na(d$refit_status)]
      data.frame(TreeID      = tid,
                 attempted   = length(st),
                 ok          = sum(st == "ok"),
                 no_anchor   = sum(st == "no_anchor"),
                 few_pts     = sum(st == "too_few_pts"),
                 fit_failed  = sum(st == "fit_failed"),
                 med_masked  = suppressWarnings(
                                 median(d$refit_n_masked, na.rm = TRUE)),
                 # How the mask was placed, and how far the lean moved it from
                 # the old anchor-centre position. A large med_shift with a high
                 # ok count is the lean correction earning its keep; "none" in
                 # bracket/below/above means the fit had no context and fell
                 # back to the vertical assumption for that slice.
                 brack       = sum(d$refit_lean_mode == "bracket", na.rm = TRUE),
                 extrap      = sum(d$refit_lean_mode %in% c("below", "above"), na.rm = TRUE),
                 no_lean     = sum(d$refit_lean_mode == "none", na.rm = TRUE),
                 med_shift   = suppressWarnings(
                                 round(median(d$refit_pred_shift, na.rm = TRUE), 4)),
                 stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    }))
    tab <- tab[tab$attempted > 0L, , drop = FALSE]
    cat(sprintf("\n[%s] Masked refit results\n", label))
    if (nrow(tab) == 0L) { cat("  (no target slices)\n"); return(invisible(NULL)) }
    print(tab, row.names = FALSE)
    cat(sprintf("  TOTAL: %d attempted -> %d refit (%.1f%%) | %d no anchor, %d too few points, %d fit failed\n",
                sum(tab$attempted), sum(tab$ok),
                100 * sum(tab$ok) / max(1L, sum(tab$attempted)),
                sum(tab$no_anchor), sum(tab$few_pts), sum(tab$fit_failed)))
    cat(sprintf("  Mask placement: %d bracketed | %d one-sided | %d no lean context | median offset from anchor centre %.4f m\n",
                sum(tab$brack), sum(tab$extrap), sum(tab$no_lean),
                suppressWarnings(median(tab$med_shift, na.rm = TRUE))))
    invisible(tab)
  }

  refit_summary_1 <- .refit_summary(refit_flagged_1, "las_1")
  refit_summary_2 <- .refit_summary(refit_flagged_2, "las_2")

  # ── Outputs ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # ellipses_zt_*_refit_all: every slice that is either kept by cleaning or
  # successfully refit, with the refit geometry in place. NOT re-cleaned – the
  # refit ellipses have not been through consensus or MAD, so this is a fitting
  # product, not a validated one.
  .collect_refit <- function(refit_flagged) {
    if (is.null(refit_flagged)) return(NULL)
    lapply(refit_flagged, function(d) {
      keep <- (!d$spike) | (d$refit & d$refit_status == "ok" & !is.na(d$refit_status))
      d[keep, , drop = FALSE]
    })
  }

  ellipses_zt_1_refit_all <- .collect_refit(refit_flagged_1)
  ellipses_zt_2_refit_all <- .collect_refit(refit_flagged_2)

  cat(sprintf(
    "\nSlices available after refit:\n  las_1: %d (was %d) | las_2: %d (was %d)\n",
    sum(sapply(ellipses_zt_1_refit_all, nrow)),
    sum(sapply(ellipses_zt_1_valid_all, nrow)),
    sum(sapply(ellipses_zt_2_refit_all, nrow)),
    sum(sapply(ellipses_zt_2_valid_all, nrow))
  ))

} else {
  cat("\nMasked refit SKIPPED (run_ellipse_refit = FALSE).\n")
  refit_flagged_1 <- refit_flagged_2 <- NULL
  ellipses_zt_1_refit_all <- ellipses_zt_1_valid_all
  ellipses_zt_2_refit_all <- ellipses_zt_2_valid_all
}
```


## 1.4 Ellipse Reclean

```{r}
#| label: params-ransac-ellipse-clean-post-refit
#| code-summary: "Parameters - Second consensus + MAD pass over the refit slice set"


# ── Parameters ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# NULL = inherit the Step 1.2 value, so this pass is identical unless you
# deliberately loosen or tighten it. The refit slices were fitted against a
# masked point set anchored on their neighbour, so they are biased TOWARD
# agreeing with that neighbour – running the same tolerances here is the
# conservative choice, not a lenient one.
consensus2_frac_centre <- NULL
consensus2_frac_minor  <- NULL
consensus2_frac_major  <- NULL
consensus2_tol_floor   <- NULL
consensus2_tol_cap     <- NULL
consensus2_max_gap     <- NULL
consensus2_sort_axes   <- NULL

consensus2_use_local_lean <- NULL   # NULL = inherit Step 1.2
consensus2_lean_k         <- NULL   # NULL = inherit Step 1.2

mad2_minor_mult  <- NULL
mad2_minor_min_n <- NULL
run_mad2_minor   <- NULL

mad2_major_mult  <- NULL
mad2_major_min_n <- NULL
run_mad2_major   <- NULL

run_ellipse_cleaning_2 <- TRUE   # FALSE = pass the refit set through as-is

.par_apply("params-ransac-ellipse-clean-post-refit")
```

```{r}
#| label: ransac-ellipse-clean-post-refit
#| code-summary: "Second consensus + MAD pass over the refit slice set"

.c2 <- function(x, fallback) if (is.null(x)) fallback else x

.c2_frac_centre <- .c2(consensus2_frac_centre, consensus_frac_centre)
.c2_frac_minor  <- .c2(consensus2_frac_minor,  consensus_frac_minor)
.c2_frac_major  <- .c2(consensus2_frac_major,  consensus_frac_major)
.c2_tol_floor   <- if (is.null(consensus2_tol_floor)) consensus_tol_floor else consensus2_tol_floor
.c2_tol_cap     <- if (is.null(consensus2_tol_cap))   consensus_tol_cap   else consensus2_tol_cap
.c2_max_gap     <- if (is.null(consensus2_max_gap))   consensus_max_gap   else consensus2_max_gap
.c2_sort_axes   <- .c2(consensus2_sort_axes, consensus_sort_axes)
.c2_mad_on      <- .c2(run_mad2_minor,   run_mad_minor)
.c2_mad_mult    <- .c2(mad2_minor_mult,  mad_minor_mult)
.c2_mad_n       <- .c2(mad2_minor_min_n, mad_minor_min_n)
.c2_madA_on     <- .c2(run_mad2_major,   run_mad_major)
.c2_madA_mult   <- .c2(mad2_major_mult,  mad_major_mult)
.c2_madA_n      <- .c2(mad2_major_min_n, mad_major_min_n)
.c2_lean_on     <- .c2(consensus2_use_local_lean, consensus_use_local_lean)
.c2_lean_k      <- .c2(consensus2_lean_k,         consensus_lean_k)

# ── Build the input set ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Candidates are the slices standing after the refit: kept by pass 1, or
# successfully refit. Everything else is dropped rather than re-tested – a slice
# that failed consensus and could not be refit has nothing new to offer.
#
# The stale flag and derived columns from pass 1 are stripped first, so nothing
# from the old verdict leaks into the new one. minor_len, major_len and ell_ecc
# especially: all are recomputed by .consensus_flag_one(), but only if absent,
# and for a refit slice the pass-1 values describe the ellipse that was REPLACED.
# .strip_pass1, .refit_candidates, .empty_clean_entry and .clean2_with_empties are
# defined in Section 0.5 (ellipse-pipeline-functions), shared with Stage 1A.
# ── Run ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if (run_ellipse_cleaning_2) {

  if (!exists("refit_flagged_1") || is.null(refit_flagged_1))
    stop("refit_flagged_1 not found – run the ransac-ellipse-refit-masked chunk first.")

  cand_1 <- .refit_candidates(refit_flagged_1)
  cand_2 <- .refit_candidates(refit_flagged_2)

  .clean2_args <- list(
    frac_c        = .c2_frac_centre,
    frac_maj      = .c2_frac_major,
    frac_min      = .c2_frac_minor,
    max_gap       = .c2_max_gap,
    sort_axes     = .c2_sort_axes,
    tol_floor     = .c2_tol_floor,
    tol_cap       = .c2_tol_cap,
    do_mad        = .c2_mad_on,
    mad_mult      = .c2_mad_mult,
    mad_min_n     = .c2_mad_n,
    do_mad_maj    = .c2_madA_on,
    mad_maj_mult  = .c2_madA_mult,
    mad_maj_min_n = .c2_madA_n,
    use_local_lean = .c2_lean_on,
    lean_k         = .c2_lean_k
  )

  clean2_result_1 <- .clean2_with_empties(cand_1, .clean2_args, "las_1")
  clean2_result_2 <- .clean2_with_empties(cand_2, .clean2_args, "las_2")

  # ── Summary ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Split by provenance: a refit slice failing this pass means the second
  # attempt did not produce something its neighbours accept, which is the
  # number that tells you whether the refit is earning its place.
  .print_clean2_summary <- function(clean_result, label) {
    cat(sprintf(
      paste0("\n[%s] Post-refit cleaning - consensus, MAD semi-minor, MAD semi-major\n",
             "      centre <= %.0f%% mean semi-minor | minor <= %.0f%% lower ",
             "semi-minor | major <= %.0f%% lower semi-major\n",
             "      MAD semi-minor: %s (mult = %.1f, min n = %d)\n",
             "      MAD semi-major: %s (mult = %.1f, min n = %d)\n"),
      label, .c2_frac_centre * 100, .c2_frac_minor * 100, .c2_frac_major * 100,
      if (.c2_mad_on)  "on" else "off", .c2_mad_mult,  .c2_mad_n,
      if (.c2_madA_on) "on" else "off", .c2_madA_mult, .c2_madA_n))

    if (is.null(clean_result) || length(clean_result) == 0L) {
      cat("  (no trees)\n"); return(invisible(NULL))
    }

    tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(clean_result), function(tid) {
      r <- clean_result[[tid]]
      f <- r$flagged
      if (is.null(f) || nrow(f) == 0L) {
        return(data.frame(TreeID = tid, in_slices = 0L, of_which_new = 0L,
                          orphan = 0L, madB = 0L, madA = 0L, kept = 0L,
                          new_kept = 0L, new_pct = NA_real_,
                          stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
      }

      is_refit <- if ("refit" %in% names(f)) f$refit else rep(FALSE, nrow(f))
      dropped  <- f$no_consensus | f$mad_minor_out | f$mad_major_out

      data.frame(
        TreeID       = tid,
        in_slices    = r$ellipses_before,
        of_which_new = sum(is_refit),
        orphan       = r$n_removed_orphan,
        madB         = r$n_removed_mad,
        madA         = r$n_removed_mad_maj,
        kept         = r$ellipses_after,
        new_kept     = sum(is_refit & !dropped),
        new_pct      = if (sum(is_refit) > 0L)
                         round(100 * sum(is_refit & !dropped) / sum(is_refit), 1)
                       else NA_real_,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }))

    print(tab, row.names = FALSE)
    cat(sprintf(
      "  TOTAL: %d in -> %d kept (%.1f%%) | %d orphaned, %d MAD semi-minor, %d MAD semi-major\n",
      sum(tab$in_slices), sum(tab$kept),
      100 * sum(tab$kept) / max(1L, sum(tab$in_slices)),
      sum(tab$orphan), sum(tab$madB), sum(tab$madA)))
    cat(sprintf(
      "  Refit slices: %d entered -> %d survived (%.1f%%)\n",
      sum(tab$of_which_new), sum(tab$new_kept),
      100 * sum(tab$new_kept) / max(1L, sum(tab$of_which_new))))
    cat(sprintf("  Stems left with no slices: %d\n", sum(tab$kept == 0L)))
    invisible(tab)
  }

  clean2_summary_1 <- .print_clean2_summary(clean2_result_1, "las_1")
  clean2_summary_2 <- .print_clean2_summary(clean2_result_2, "las_2")

  ellipses_zt_1_valid2_all <- lapply(clean2_result_1, `[[`, "valid")
  ellipses_zt_2_valid2_all <- lapply(clean2_result_2, `[[`, "valid")
  clean2_results_1_all     <- clean2_result_1
  clean2_results_2_all     <- clean2_result_2

} else {

  cat("\nPost-refit cleaning SKIPPED (run_ellipse_cleaning_2 = FALSE).\n",
      "The refit slice set is used as-is.\n")
  ellipses_zt_1_valid2_all <- ellipses_zt_1_refit_all
  ellipses_zt_2_valid2_all <- ellipses_zt_2_refit_all
  clean2_results_1_all     <- NULL
  clean2_results_2_all     <- NULL
}

# ── Cleaning parameter record (pass 2) ────────────────────────────────────────
cp2 <- list(
  method         = "post_refit_consensus_adaptive_then_mad_minor_then_mad_major",
  frac_centre    = .c2_frac_centre,
  frac_minor     = .c2_frac_minor,
  frac_major     = .c2_frac_major,
  tol_floor      = .c2_tol_floor,
  tol_cap        = .c2_tol_cap,
  max_gap        = .c2_max_gap,
  sort_axes      = .c2_sort_axes,
  mad_minor      = .c2_mad_on,
  mad_minor_mult = .c2_mad_mult,
  mad_minor_n    = .c2_mad_n,
  mad_major      = .c2_madA_on,
  mad_major_mult = .c2_madA_mult,
  mad_major_n    = .c2_madA_n
)

cat(sprintf(
  "\nPost-refit valid ellipses:\n  las_1: %d slices across %d trees | las_2: %d slices across %d trees\n",
  sum(sapply(ellipses_zt_1_valid2_all, nrow)),
  length(Filter(function(d) !is.null(d) && nrow(d) > 0, ellipses_zt_1_valid2_all)),
  sum(sapply(ellipses_zt_2_valid2_all, nrow)),
  length(Filter(function(d) !is.null(d) && nrow(d) > 0, ellipses_zt_2_valid2_all))
))
```

### Vis - Reclean MAD Select
```{r}
#| label: params-diag-mad2-minor-multiplier
#| code-summary: "Parameters - Diagnostic: MAD z-scores of semi-minor axis after refit, to choose mad2_minor_mult"


# ── Parameters ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
mad2_diag_treeids_1 <- NULL                  # NULL = every tree; else c(1, 13, ...)
mad2_diag_mult_grid <- c(2, 3, 4.5, 6, 8)    # multipliers to compare in the table

mad2_diag_ref_lines <- c(3, 6)               # multipliers drawn on the plots
mad2_diag_pad       <- 0.1                   # y-axis padding beyond min/max z
mad2_diag_plot      <- TRUE                  # FALSE = sweep table only

.par_apply("params-diag-mad2-minor-multiplier")
```

```{r}
#| label: diag-mad2-minor-multiplier
#| code-summary: "Diagnostic: MAD z-scores of semi-minor axis after refit, to choose mad2_minor_mult"
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 4

mad2_diag_show      <- if (exists(".c2_mad_mult")) .c2_mad_mult else
                       if (exists("mad_minor_mult")) mad_minor_mult else 3.0

# ── Build the per-slice score frame from the SECOND cleaning output ───────────
# Scores are computed on the pass-2 consensus survivors only, matching where the
# pass-2 MAD stage actually runs. The population differs from the first
# diagnostic in two ways: refit slices have entered it, and slices that pass-1
# consensus dropped and the refit could not recover are gone. Both shift the
# median and MAD, so a multiplier chosen on the first diagnostic does not carry
# over – that is the reason to run this one.
.mad2_diag_frame <- function(clean2_result, label) {
  if (is.null(clean2_result) || length(clean2_result) == 0L) return(NULL)

  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(clean2_result), function(tid) {
    df <- clean2_result[[tid]]$flagged
    if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0L) return(NULL)
    df <- as.data.frame(df)

    # minor_len is rewritten by .consensus_flag_one() during pass 2, so for a
    # refit slice it describes the NEW ellipse, not the one it replaced.
    b <- if ("minor_len" %in% names(df)) df$minor_len else
           pmin(df$semi_a, df$semi_b)

    elig <- !df$unfitted & !df$no_consensus & !is.na(b)
    if (sum(elig) < 2L) return(NULL)

    med  <- median(b[elig], na.rm = TRUE)
    madr <- mad(b[elig], center = med, na.rm = TRUE)   # includes 1.4826
    if (is.na(madr) || madr < 1e-12) madr <- NA_real_

    data.frame(
      epoch   = label,
      TreeID  = tid,
      slice_z = df$slice_z[elig],
      h       = df$slice_z[elig] - min(df$slice_z, na.rm = TRUE),
      minor   = b[elig],
      z       = (b[elig] - med) / madr,
      refit   = if ("refit" %in% names(df)) isTRUE(df$refit[elig]) |
                  df$refit[elig] else rep(FALSE, sum(elig)),
      med     = med,
      madr    = madr,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }))
}

if (!exists("clean2_results_1_all") || is.null(clean2_results_1_all))
  stop("clean2_results_1_all not found – run the ransac-ellipse-clean-post-refit chunk first.")

mad2_diag_1 <- .mad2_diag_frame(clean2_results_1_all, "las_1")
mad2_diag_2 <- .mad2_diag_frame(clean2_results_2_all, "las_2")
mad2_diag   <- dplyr::bind_rows(mad2_diag_1, mad2_diag_2)

if (is.null(mad2_diag) || nrow(mad2_diag) == 0L)
  stop("No scoreable slices – every tree has fewer than 2 pass-2 consensus survivors.")

# ── Multiplier sweep: what each choice would remove ───────────────────────────
# Split by provenance. If refit slices are flagged at a much higher rate than
# originals, the refit is producing geometry the stem's own distribution
# rejects, and the multiplier is not the thing to adjust – the mask is.
sweep2 <- do.call(rbind, lapply(mad2_diag_mult_grid, function(k) {
  d <- mad2_diag[!is.na(mad2_diag$z), ]
  do.call(rbind, lapply(split(d, d$epoch), function(dd) {
    flag <- abs(dd$z) > k
    data.frame(
      mult          = k,
      epoch         = dd$epoch[1],
      n_slices      = nrow(dd),
      n_flagged     = sum(flag),
      pct_flagged   = round(100 * mean(flag), 2),
      n_refit       = sum(dd$refit),
      pct_refit_hit = if (sum(dd$refit) > 0L)
                        round(100 * mean(flag[dd$refit]), 1) else NA_real_,
      pct_orig_hit  = if (sum(!dd$refit) > 0L)
                        round(100 * mean(flag[!dd$refit]), 1) else NA_real_,
      n_trees_hit   = length(unique(dd$TreeID[flag])),
      # A tree losing most of its slices to this filter is the failure mode to
      # watch: it means the stem's own spread, not a few bad fits, is driving it.
      worst_tree_pct = round(100 * max(c(0, sapply(split(dd, dd$TreeID),
                              function(t) mean(abs(t$z) > k)))), 1),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }))
}))

cat("── MAD semi-minor multiplier sweep (post-refit, pass 2) ──\n")
cat("z = (b - median(b)) / MAD  [MAD includes the 1.4826 constant]\n")
cat("pct_refit_hit / pct_orig_hit = flag rate within each provenance group\n\n")
print(sweep2[order(sweep2$epoch, sweep2$mult), ], row.names = FALSE)

cat(sprintf("\nScore range: las_1 |z| max %.2f | las_2 |z| max %.2f\n",
            suppressWarnings(max(abs(mad2_diag$z[mad2_diag$epoch == "las_1"]), na.rm = TRUE)),
            suppressWarnings(max(abs(mad2_diag$z[mad2_diag$epoch == "las_2"]), na.rm = TRUE))))
cat(sprintf("Refit slices in the scored set: las_1 %d of %d | las_2 %d of %d\n",
            sum(mad2_diag$refit[mad2_diag$epoch == "las_1"]),
            sum(mad2_diag$epoch == "las_1"),
            sum(mad2_diag$refit[mad2_diag$epoch == "las_2"]),
            sum(mad2_diag$epoch == "las_2")))
cat(sprintf("Currently effective: pass-2 multiplier = %.1f\n", mad2_diag_show))

# ── Per-tree dual-axis plots ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Left axis  : z score. The y range is clipped to that tree's own observed range
#              (+/- mad2_diag_pad), so the shape of the series is readable
#              rather than squashed by the threshold lines – which means a
#              reference line above the highest score simply does not appear on
#              that tree's panel.
# Right axis : semi-minor axis length, which is z rescaled by that tree's own
#              median and MAD (b = med + z * MAD). The mapping is exact and
#              linear, so one series carries both readings – the right axis is a
#              second way of reading the same points, not a second variable.
# Point fill : hollow = refit slice, solid = original. A run of hollow points
#              drifting together is a refit chain, which consensus cannot catch
#              because each link agrees with the last.
if (mad2_diag_plot) {

  wanted_1 <- if (is.null(mad2_diag_treeids_1)) unique(mad2_diag_1$TreeID) else
                as.character(mad2_diag_treeids_1)

  mk_mad2_plot <- function(d, epoch_label, colour) {
    if (is.null(d) || nrow(d) == 0L || all(is.na(d$z))) return(NULL)
    d   <- d[order(d$h), ]
    med <- d$med[1]; madr <- d$madr[1]
    if (is.na(madr)) return(NULL)

    d$flagged <- abs(d$z) > mad2_diag_show
    d$grp     <- ifelse(d$flagged, "flagged",
                        ifelse(d$refit, "refit", "original"))

    z_lo <- min(d$z, na.rm = TRUE) - mad2_diag_pad
    z_hi <- max(d$z, na.rm = TRUE) + mad2_diag_pad

    ggplot(d, aes(h, z)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = c(-1, 1) * rep(mad2_diag_ref_lines, each = 2),
                 linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = c(-1, 1) * mad2_diag_show,
                 linetype = "dashed", colour = "#D7263D", linewidth = 0.6) +
      geom_line(colour = colour, alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 0.4) +
      geom_point(aes(shape = grp, size = grp), colour = colour,
                 fill = "white", stroke = 1.1, alpha = 0.9) +
      scale_shape_manual(values = c(original = 16, refit = 21, flagged = 4),
                         guide = "none") +
      scale_size_manual(values  = c(original = 2.2, refit = 2.6, flagged = 3.6),
                        guide = "none") +
      scale_y_continuous(
        name     = "MAD z-score of semi-minor axis",
        sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . * madr + med, name = "Semi-minor axis b (m)")
      ) +
      # coord_cartesian clips the view without dropping rows, so the connecting
      # line still runs to an off-panel point instead of breaking. It must do
      # the clipping rather than scale_y_continuous(limits=), which would set
      # out-of-range values to NA and also recompute the secondary axis breaks
      # from the truncated data.
      coord_cartesian(ylim = c(z_lo, z_hi)) +
      labs(
        title    = sprintf("[%s] Tree %s \u2014 post-refit", epoch_label, d$TreeID[1]),
        subtitle = sprintf("median b %.4f m | MAD %.4f | %d refit of %d | %d flagged at mult %.1f",
                           med, madr, sum(d$refit), nrow(d),
                           sum(d$flagged), mad2_diag_show),
        x        = "Height above stem's lowest scored slice (m)",
        caption  = sprintf("hollow = refit | \u2715 = flagged | dashed = current mult (%.1f) | dotted = %s | y clipped to observed z \u00b1 %.1f",
                           mad2_diag_show,
                           paste(mad2_diag_ref_lines, collapse = ", "),
                           mad2_diag_pad)
      ) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 11)
  }

  for (tid in wanted_1) {
    p <- mk_mad2_plot(mad2_diag_1[mad2_diag_1$TreeID == tid, ], "las_1", COL_1)
    if (!is.null(p)) print(p)
  }
  for (tid in unique(mad2_diag_2$TreeID)) {
    p <- mk_mad2_plot(mad2_diag_2[mad2_diag_2$TreeID == tid, ], "las_2", COL_2)
    if (!is.null(p)) print(p)
  }
}
```


### Vis - slice x thresh inliers Reclean

```{r}
#| label: fig-refit-clean2-slice-status
#| standalone: true
#| fig: false
#| results: asis
#| column: page
#| code-summary: "Per-slice panels after refit and second cleaning; grey background = refit, red/orange/black borders = removal stage"

if (!second_run && params$make_plots) {

  if (!exists("refit_flagged_1") || is.null(refit_flagged_1))
    stop("refit_flagged_1 not found – run the ransac-ellipse-refit-masked chunk first.")
  if (!exists("clean2_results_1_all") || is.null(clean2_results_1_all))
    stop("clean2_results_1_all not found – run the ransac-ellipse-clean-post-refit chunk first.")

  # ── User input ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  vis_f2_treeids_1 <- NULL     # NULL = every temporal pair
  n_f2_rows        <- NULL     # NULL = every slice; k = first k from the lowest
  slice_match_eps  <- 1e-6

  # ── Appearance ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Background carries PROVENANCE (was this slice refit?), border carries
  # VERDICT (what removed it, if anything). The two are independent: a refit
  # slice that then failed second-pass consensus shows both.
  f2_bg_refit       <- "#ECCCCC"   # light grey - slice was refit
  f2_bg_plain       <- "white"
  f2_col_consensus2 <- "#D7263D"   # red    - removed by 2nd-pass consensus
  f2_col_mad2       <- "#F07C10"   # orange - removed by 2nd-pass MAD
  f2_col_mad1       <- "purple"   # black  - removed by 1st-pass MAD
  f2_col_unrefit    <- "blue"   # grey   - 1st-pass consensus removal, refit failed
  f2_px             <- 6
  f2_px_mad1        <- 10          # thicker, per spec

  slice_label_offset <- (if (is.null(ransac_slice_bot)) 0 else ransac_slice_bot) +
                        ransac_slice_width / 2

  # ── Per-slice status, read from the stored results (not recomputed) ─────────
  # Priority: a slice removed at pass 1 never reached pass 2, so its verdict
  # stands regardless of what the pass-2 frame does or doesn't contain.
  #   mad1       - dropped by the first MAD stage (never a refit target)
  #   unrefit    - dropped by first-pass consensus, refit did not succeed
  #   consensus2 - entered pass 2, dropped by consensus
  #   mad2       - entered pass 2, dropped by MAD
  #   kept       - survived everything
  .f2_status_frame <- function(refit_flagged, clean2_result, tid) {
    base <- refit_flagged[[as.character(tid)]]
    if (is.null(base) || nrow(base) == 0L) return(NULL)
    base <- as.data.frame(base)

    c2 <- clean2_result[[as.character(tid)]]$flagged
    c2 <- if (is.null(c2) || nrow(c2) == 0L) NULL else as.data.frame(c2)

    n      <- nrow(base)
    status <- rep(NA_character_, n)

    for (i in seq_len(n)) {
      if (isTRUE(base$unfitted[i])) next          # never fitted -> blank cell

      if (isTRUE(base$mad_minor_out[i]) ||
          isTRUE(base$mad_major_out[i])) { status[i] <- "mad1"; next }

      hit <- if (is.null(c2)) integer(0) else
               which(abs(c2$slice_z - base$slice_z[i]) <= slice_match_eps)

      if (length(hit) != 1L) {
        # Not carried into pass 2: first-pass consensus removal whose refit
        # failed (or was never attempted).
        status[i] <- "unrefit"
        next
      }

      status[i] <-
        if (isTRUE(c2$no_consensus[hit]))  "consensus2" else
        if (isTRUE(c2$mad_minor_out[hit]) ||
            isTRUE(c2$mad_major_out[hit]))  "mad2"       else "kept"
    }

    data.frame(
      slice_z = base$slice_z,
      dz      = base$slice_z - min(base$slice_z, na.rm = TRUE),
      status  = status,
      refit   = if ("refit" %in% names(base)) base$refit else rep(FALSE, n),
      row_idx = seq_len(n),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }

  # Geometry for a panel comes from the pass-2 frame when the slice reached it
  # (that frame is the one the second cleaning judged), else from refit_flagged.
  # Both carry the post-refit geometry, so they agree; the fallback matters only
  # for mad1 and unrefit slices, which pass 2 never saw.
  .f2_row <- function(refit_flagged, clean2_result, tid, row_idx, slice_z) {
    c2 <- clean2_result[[as.character(tid)]]$flagged
    if (!is.null(c2) && nrow(c2) > 0L) {
      c2  <- as.data.frame(c2)
      hit <- which(abs(c2$slice_z - slice_z) <= slice_match_eps)
      if (length(hit) == 1L) return(c2[hit, , drop = FALSE])
    }
    base <- as.data.frame(refit_flagged[[as.character(tid)]])
    base[row_idx, , drop = FALSE]
  }

  # ── Pair lookup: las_1 TreeID -> las_2 TreeID ──────────────────────────────
  pair_lookup <- if (exists("pairs_matched") && is.data.frame(pairs_matched) &&
                     nrow(pairs_matched) > 0L) {
    data.frame(TreeID_1 = as.character(pairs_matched$TreeID_1),
               TreeID_2 = as.character(pairs_matched$TreeID_2),
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  } else if (exists("mapping_df") && is.data.frame(mapping_df) &&
             nrow(mapping_df) > 0L) {
    data.frame(TreeID_1 = as.character(mapping_df[[col_treeid_las1]]),
               TreeID_2 = as.character(mapping_df[[col_treeid_las2]]),
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  } else {
    stop(paste0(
      "No temporal pair table available, so las_2 partners cannot be resolved.\n",
      "  Set use_csv_pairs <- TRUE (Step 1.1 loads mapping_df), or run the\n",
      "  temporal-pairing chunk first so pairs_matched exists."
    ))
  }

  pair_lookup <- unique(pair_lookup[!is.na(pair_lookup$TreeID_1) &
                                    !is.na(pair_lookup$TreeID_2), , drop = FALSE])
  pair_lookup <- pair_lookup[
    pair_lookup$TreeID_1 %in% names(refit_flagged_1) &
    pair_lookup$TreeID_2 %in% names(refit_flagged_2), , drop = FALSE]

  wanted <- if (is.null(vis_f2_treeids_1)) unique(pair_lookup$TreeID_1) else
              as.character(vis_f2_treeids_1)
  pairs_vis <- pair_lookup[match(wanted, pair_lookup$TreeID_1), , drop = FALSE]
  pairs_vis <- pairs_vis[!is.na(pairs_vis$TreeID_1), , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(pairs_vis) == 0L) stop("No renderable temporal pairs.")

  cat(sprintf("Rendering %d temporal pair(s) after refit + second cleaning.\n",
              nrow(pairs_vis)))

  las_pts_cache_shared <- list(
    las_1 = as.data.frame(las_1@data[, c("point_id", "X", "Y")]),
    las_2 = as.data.frame(las_2@data[, c("point_id", "X", "Y")])
  )

  # ── Build one stem-pair grid: rows = slice height, columns = epoch ──────────
  make_status_grid <- function(tid_1, tid_2) {

    st_1 <- .f2_status_frame(refit_flagged_1, clean2_results_1_all, tid_1)
    st_2 <- .f2_status_frame(refit_flagged_2, clean2_results_2_all, tid_2)
    if (is.null(st_1) && is.null(st_2)) return(NULL)

    dz_all <- sort(unique(round(c(if (!is.null(st_1)) st_1$dz,
                                  if (!is.null(st_2)) st_2$dz), 6)))
    keep_dz <- c(if (!is.null(st_1)) st_1$dz[!is.na(st_1$status)],
                 if (!is.null(st_2)) st_2$dz[!is.na(st_2$status)])
    if (length(keep_dz) == 0L) return(NULL)
    dz_all <- dz_all[dz_all <= max(keep_dz) + slice_match_eps]
    if (!is.null(n_f2_rows) && length(dz_all) > n_f2_rows)
      dz_all <- dz_all[seq_len(n_f2_rows)]

    cols <- list(
      list(label = "las_1", st = st_1, tid = tid_1, pts = las_pts_cache_shared$las_1,
           rf = refit_flagged_1, c2 = clean2_results_1_all),
      list(label = "las_2", st = st_2, tid = tid_2, pts = las_pts_cache_shared$las_2,
           rf = refit_flagged_2, c2 = clean2_results_2_all)
    )

    panel_matrix  <- vector("list", length(dz_all))
    status_matrix <- vector("list", length(dz_all))
    refit_matrix  <- vector("list", length(dz_all))

    for (r in seq_along(dz_all)) {
      cells <- vector("list", length(cols))
      stats <- vector("list", length(cols))
      rfs   <- vector("list", length(cols))

      for (k in seq_along(cols)) {
        cc <- cols[[k]]
        if (is.null(cc$st)) { cells[[k]] <- NULL; stats[[k]] <- NA_character_
                              rfs[[k]] <- FALSE; next }

        hit <- which(abs(cc$st$dz - dz_all[r]) <= slice_match_eps)
        if (length(hit) != 1L || is.na(cc$st$status[hit])) {
          cells[[k]] <- NULL; stats[[k]] <- NA_character_; rfs[[k]] <- FALSE; next
        }

        row_data <- .f2_row(cc$rf, cc$c2, cc$tid,
                            cc$st$row_idx[hit], cc$st$slice_z[hit])

        cells[[k]] <- make_threshold_panel(row_data, cc$pts)
        stats[[k]] <- cc$st$status[hit]
        rfs[[k]]   <- isTRUE(cc$st$refit[hit])
      }

      panel_matrix[[r]]  <- cells
      status_matrix[[r]] <- stats
      refit_matrix[[r]]  <- rfs
    }

    list(
      matrix     = panel_matrix,
      status     = status_matrix,
      refit      = refit_matrix,
      row_labels = sprintf("h \u2248 %.3f m", dz_all + slice_label_offset),
      col_labels = vapply(cols, function(x) x$label, character(1))
    )
  }

  # ── Renderer ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # The background sits on the wrapping div, not the image, so it shows as a
  # tint around a panel whose own plot area is transparent.
  render_status_grid <- function(grid_obj, lb_id, w = 3.2, h = 3.2, dpi = 140) {

    panel_matrix  <- grid_obj$matrix
    status_matrix <- grid_obj$status
    refit_matrix  <- grid_obj$refit
    row_labels    <- grid_obj$row_labels
    col_labels    <- grid_obj$col_labels
    n_col         <- length(col_labels)

    has_content <- any(vapply(panel_matrix, function(row)
      any(!vapply(row, is.null, logical(1))), logical(1)))
    if (!has_content) return(HTML("<p>No data.</p>"))

    encode_plot <- function(p) {
      if (is.null(p)) return(NA_character_)
      tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")
      on.exit(unlink(tmp), add = TRUE)
      # bg = NA keeps the panel transparent so the wrapper tint shows through.
      ggsave(tmp, plot = p, width = w, height = h, dpi = dpi, bg = NA)
      paste0("data:image/png;base64,", base64enc::base64encode(tmp))
    }

    border_spec <- function(status) {
      switch(as.character(status),
             "consensus2" = c(f2_col_consensus2, f2_px),
             "mad2"       = c(f2_col_mad2,       f2_px),
             "mad1"       = c(f2_col_mad1,       f2_px_mad1),
             "unrefit"    = c(f2_col_unrefit,    f2_px),
             c("transparent", f2_px_mad1))   # kept: reserve the widest gutter
    }

    cell_tag <- function(src, status, is_refit) {
      if (is.na(src))
        return('<div style="background:#f4f4f4;border-radius:6px;min-height:120px;"></div>')
      bs  <- border_spec(status)
      bg  <- if (isTRUE(is_refit)) f2_bg_refit else f2_bg_plain
      sprintf(
        '<div style="background:%s;border:%spx solid %s;border-radius:6px;
                     box-sizing:border-box;padding:2px;">
           <img src="%s"
                style="width:100%%;display:block;border-radius:4px;cursor:zoom-in;"
                onclick="openLb_%s(this.src)" />
         </div>',
        bg, bs[2], bs[1], src, lb_id
      )
    }

    header_row <- sprintf(
      '<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:90px repeat(%d,1fr);gap:6px;margin-bottom:4px;"><div></div>%s</div>',
      n_col,
      paste(vapply(col_labels, function(lbl)
        sprintf('<div style="font-size:12px;font-weight:600;text-align:center;padding:2px;">%s</div>', lbl),
        character(1)), collapse = ""))

    swatch <- function(col, px, txt, bg = "white")
      sprintf('<span style="display:inline-block;width:16px;height:16px;background:%s;
                            border:%dpx solid %s;vertical-align:-3px;
                            margin:0 5px 0 14px;box-sizing:border-box;"></span>%s',
              bg, px, col, txt)

    legend <- sprintf(
      '<div style="font-size:12px;margin:0 0 10px 2px;line-height:1.9;">%s%s%s%s%s</div>',
      swatch("#cccccc", 1, "refit slice (grey background)", f2_bg_refit),
      swatch(f2_col_consensus2, f2_px,      "2nd-pass consensus removal"),
      swatch(f2_col_mad2,       f2_px,      "2nd-pass MAD removal"),
      swatch(f2_col_mad1,       f2_px_mad1, "1st-pass MAD removal"),
      swatch(f2_col_unrefit,    f2_px,      "consensus removal, refit failed"))

    body_rows <- paste(
      vapply(seq_along(panel_matrix), function(r) {
        cells <- vapply(panel_matrix[[r]], encode_plot, character(1))
        stats <- status_matrix[[r]]
        rfs   <- refit_matrix[[r]]
        imgs  <- paste(vapply(seq_along(cells),
                              function(k) cell_tag(cells[k], stats[[k]], rfs[[k]]),
                              character(1)), collapse = "")
        sprintf(
          '<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:90px repeat(%d,1fr);gap:6px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:6px;">
             <div style="font-size:11px;font-weight:600;">%s</div>%s
           </div>',
          n_col, row_labels[r], imgs
        )
      }, character(1)),
      collapse = "\n"
    )

    HTML(sprintf('
<style>
  #lbOv_%s{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9999;
    background:rgba(0,0,0,.82);align-items:center;justify-content:center;}
  #lbOv_%s.open{display:flex;}
  #lbOv_%s img{max-width:95vw;max-height:95vh;border-radius:6px;background:#fff;
    box-shadow:0 4px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.6);}
  #lbCl_%s{position:fixed;top:16px;right:20px;font-size:32px;color:#fff;
    cursor:pointer;line-height:1;user-select:none;z-index:10000;}
</style>
<div id="lbOv_%s" onclick="if(event.target===this)closeLb_%s()">
  <span id="lbCl_%s" onclick="closeLb_%s()">&#x2715;</span>
  <img id="lbIm_%s" src=""/>
</div>
<div style="padding:10px;overflow-x:auto;">%s%s%s</div>
<script>
  window.openLb_%s  = s => {
    document.getElementById("lbIm_%s").src = s;
    document.getElementById("lbOv_%s").classList.add("open");
  };
  window.closeLb_%s = () =>
    document.getElementById("lbOv_%s").classList.remove("open");
</script>',
      lb_id, lb_id, lb_id, lb_id,
      lb_id, lb_id, lb_id, lb_id, lb_id,
      legend, header_row, body_rows,
      lb_id, lb_id, lb_id, lb_id, lb_id
    ))
  }

  # ── One grid per temporal pair ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  pair_blocks <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(pairs_vis)), function(i) {

    tid_1 <- pairs_vis$TreeID_1[i]
    tid_2 <- pairs_vis$TreeID_2[i]

    grid_obj <- make_status_grid(tid_1, tid_2)
    if (is.null(grid_obj)) return(NULL)

    n_of <- function(v) sum(vapply(grid_obj$status,
                                   function(rw) sum(vapply(rw, function(s)
                                     !is.na(s) && s == v, logical(1))),
                                   integer(1)))
    n_refit <- sum(vapply(grid_obj$refit,
                          function(rw) sum(vapply(rw, isTRUE, logical(1))),
                          integer(1)))

    tagList(
      h3(sprintf("Pair %d of %d \u2014 las_1 TreeID %s \u2194 las_2 TreeID %s",
                 i, nrow(pairs_vis), tid_1, tid_2)),
      h4(sprintf("%d refit | kept %d | consensus2 %d | mad2 %d | mad1 %d | unrefit %d",
                 n_refit, n_of("kept"), n_of("consensus2"),
                 n_of("mad2"), n_of("mad1"), n_of("unrefit"))),
      render_status_grid(grid_obj, sprintf("f2grid_%s_%s", tid_1, tid_2))
    )
  })

  browsable(tagList(
    h3("Slice status after refit and second cleaning"),
    h4("Rows = slice-centre height above each stem's own lowest point \u2014 columns = epoch"),
    h4("Grey background = refit | red = 2nd-pass consensus | orange = 2nd-pass MAD | thick black = 1st-pass MAD"),
    pair_blocks
  ))
}
```


### Diag - RANSAC convergence (best inlier fraction vs iteration)

Reads the convergence history recorded **during** fitting – `inlier_history`,
`segs_history` and `n_cand_pts`, written per slice by
`custom_ransac_ellipse_fit(track_history = TRUE)` in Step 1.1 and overwritten
for refit slices in Step 1.3b. No fitting happens here; this chunk only reads
and plots, so the curves describe the exact runs that produced the ellipses on
record.

The fitter ranks hypotheses by angular coverage first and inlier count only as a
tie-break, so the inlier series is not a running maximum: adopting a
better-covered ellipse can lower the count. The min iteration is therefore
defined as the first iteration at which the fit reached **both** its final
coverage and its final inlier count – the iteration the winning hypothesis was
adopted – not the first time the inlier count peaked.

```{r}
#| label: params-diag-ransac-convergence
#| code-summary: "Parameters - Plot recorded RANSAC convergence: best inlier fraction vs iteration, and the min-iteration distribution"


# ── Parameters ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
run_conv_diag    <- TRUE
conv_treeids_1   <- NULL     # NULL = every stem present; else las_1 IDs c(1, 13)
conv_plot_curves <- TRUE     # FALSE = min-iteration distribution only

# NOTHING IN THIS CHUNK IS ALLOWED TO STOP A RUN. It reports on the fit; it does
# not feed it, and no later chunk and no save manifest reads anything it makes.
# A missing precondition here means "there is nothing to show", not "the pipeline
# is wrong" - so every exit below prints and stands down. An earlier version
# called stop() when no history had been recorded, which failed a 148-minute
# batch pair after the pipeline itself had completed successfully.
.conv_ok <- isTRUE(run_conv_diag)

.par_apply("params-diag-ransac-convergence")
```

```{r}
#| label: diag-ransac-convergence
#| code-summary: "Plot recorded RANSAC convergence: best inlier fraction vs iteration, and the min-iteration distribution"
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 5

if (.conv_ok && (!exists("ellipses_zt_1_valid2_all") || is.null(ellipses_zt_1_valid2_all))) {
  cat("\n[conv] SKIPPED: ellipses_zt_1_valid2_all not found - run the Step 1.4 reclean chunk first.\n")
  .conv_ok <- FALSE
}

if (.conv_ok) {

  # ── Unpack the stored histories ────────────────────────────────────────────
  # origin: "original" = fitted in Step 1.1 and kept by the FIRST cleaning pass
  #         "refit"    = refitted in Step 1.3b and kept by the SECOND pass
  # Both are present in the post-reclean set; the refit flag distinguishes them.
  .conv_unpack <- function(valid_list, epoch) {
    if (is.null(valid_list) || length(valid_list) == 0L) return(NULL)

    dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(valid_list), function(tid) {
      df <- valid_list[[tid]]
      if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0L) return(NULL)
      df <- as.data.frame(df)

      if (!"inlier_history" %in% names(df)) return(NULL)

      dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(df)), function(r) {

        h_inl  <- df$inlier_history[[r]]
        h_segs <- df$segs_history[[r]]
        n_pts  <- df$n_cand_pts[r]

        if (length(h_inl) == 0L || is.na(n_pts) || n_pts <= 0L) return(NULL)
        if (length(h_segs) != length(h_inl)) h_segs <- rep(NA_integer_, length(h_inl))

        is_refit <- "refit" %in% names(df) && isTRUE(df$refit[r])

        data.frame(
          epoch      = epoch,
          TreeID     = as.character(tid),
          stem       = sprintf("%s T%s", epoch, tid),
          slice_id   = sprintf("%s|%s|%d", epoch, tid, r),
          slice_z    = df$slice_z[r],
          h          = df$slice_z[r] - min(df$slice_z, na.rm = TRUE),
          origin     = if (is_refit) "refit" else "original",
          n_cand_pts = as.integer(n_pts),
          iteration  = seq_along(h_inl),
          best_inl   = as.integer(h_inl),
          best_segs  = as.integer(h_segs),
          frac       = h_inl / n_pts,
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
      }))
    }))
  }

  conv_curves <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    .conv_unpack(ellipses_zt_1_valid2_all, "las_1"),
    .conv_unpack(ellipses_zt_2_valid2_all, "las_2")
  )

  if (is.null(conv_curves) || nrow(conv_curves) == 0L) {
    cat(paste0(
      "\n[conv] SKIPPED: no convergence history stored.\n",
      "  Set ransac_track_history <- TRUE in Step 1.1 and re-run the fit\n",
      "  (and the refit, for refit slices) before using this diagnostic.\n"))
    .conv_ok <- FALSE
  }
}

if (.conv_ok) {

  if (!is.null(conv_treeids_1)) {
    keep_1 <- conv_curves$epoch == "las_1" &
              conv_curves$TreeID %in% as.character(conv_treeids_1)
    keep_2 <- rep(FALSE, nrow(conv_curves))
    if (exists("pairs_matched") && is.data.frame(pairs_matched)) {
      p2 <- as.character(pairs_matched$TreeID_2[
              as.character(pairs_matched$TreeID_1) %in% as.character(conv_treeids_1)])
      keep_2 <- conv_curves$epoch == "las_2" & conv_curves$TreeID %in% p2
    }
    .conv_sel <- conv_curves[keep_1 | keep_2, ]
    # An unmatched stem selection is a typo in conv_treeids_1, not a broken
    # pipeline: say so and show everything rather than ending the run.
    if (nrow(.conv_sel) == 0L)
      cat("\n[conv] no stored history for the requested stems - showing every stem instead.\n")
    else
      conv_curves <- .conv_sel
  }

  # ── Min iteration ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # First iteration at which BOTH the final coverage and the final inlier count
  # are held. Using the inlier count alone would return an earlier iteration
  # whenever a high-inlier, poorly-covered hypothesis led before being displaced.
  conv_min_iter <- conv_curves |>
    dplyr::group_by(epoch, TreeID, stem, slice_id, slice_z, h, origin, n_cand_pts) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      final_segs = dplyr::last(best_segs),
      final_inl  = dplyr::last(best_inl),
      best_frac  = dplyr::last(best_inl) / dplyr::first(n_cand_pts),
      n_iter_run = dplyr::n(),
      min_iter   = min(iteration[
                     (is.na(best_segs) | best_segs >= dplyr::last(best_segs)) &
                     best_inl >= dplyr::last(best_inl)]),
      .groups    = "drop"
    )

  cat(sprintf("\n[conv] %d slices with stored history | %d original, %d refit\n",
              nrow(conv_min_iter),
              sum(conv_min_iter$origin == "original"),
              sum(conv_min_iter$origin == "refit")))
  print(summary(conv_min_iter$min_iter))

  by_origin <- conv_min_iter |>
    dplyr::group_by(origin) |>
    dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n(),
                     median_min_iter = median(min_iter),
                     q90_min_iter    = quantile(min_iter, 0.9),
                     median_best_frac = round(median(best_frac), 3),
                     .groups = "drop")
  print(as.data.frame(by_origin), row.names = FALSE)

  # ── Plot 1: best inlier fraction vs iteration, one line per slice ───────────
  if (conv_plot_curves) {
    for (st in unique(conv_curves$stem)) {
      d <- conv_curves[conv_curves$stem == st, ]
      if (nrow(d) == 0L) next

      p <- ggplot(d, aes(iteration, frac, group = slice_id, colour = origin)) +
        geom_line(linewidth = 0.35, alpha = 0.6) +
        scale_colour_manual(values = c(original = "#2166AC", refit = "#B2182B"),
                            name = "Ellipse origin") +
        scale_y_continuous(name = "Best inlier fraction so far", limits = c(0, 1)) +
        scale_x_continuous(name = "RANSAC iteration") +
        labs(
          title    = sprintf("%s \u2014 recorded RANSAC convergence per slice", st),
          subtitle = sprintf("%d slices | inliers as a fraction of the candidate points that fit drew from",
                             length(unique(d$slice_id))),
          caption  = "Dips mark iterations where a better-covered hypothesis replaced one with more inliers"
        ) +
        theme_bw(base_size = 11)
      print(p)
    }
  }

  # ── Plot 2: distribution of min iterations, pooled ─────────────────────────
  # Shape = stem, so the two stems of a temporal pair are separate symbols.
  # Colour = origin: blue for ellipses kept by the first cleaning pass, red for
  # refit ellipses kept by the second. Epoch is deliberately not encoded.
  n_stems    <- length(unique(conv_min_iter$stem))
  shape_pool <- c(16, 17, 15, 3, 7, 8, 1, 2, 0, 5, 6, 4, 18, 9, 10, 11, 12,
                  13, 14, 21, 22, 23, 24, 25, 20)
  if (n_stems > length(shape_pool))
    warning(sprintf("%d stems but only %d distinct shapes – shapes will repeat.",
                    n_stems, length(shape_pool)))
  shape_vals <- setNames(rep_len(shape_pool, n_stems),
                         sort(unique(conv_min_iter$stem)))

  p_dist <- ggplot(conv_min_iter,
                   aes(x = min_iter, y = origin, colour = origin, shape = stem)) +
    geom_jitter(height = 0.3, width = 0, size = 2.2, alpha = 0.8, stroke = 0.7) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(original = "#2166AC", refit = "#B2182B"),
                        name = "Ellipse origin") +
    scale_shape_manual(values = shape_vals, name = "Stem") +
    scale_x_continuous(name = "Min iteration (winning hypothesis adopted)") +
    labs(
      y        = NULL,
      title    = "Distribution of min iterations, pooled across stems and epochs",
      subtitle = sprintf("%d slices across %d stems | blue = kept by the first cleaning pass, red = refit kept by the second",
                         nrow(conv_min_iter), n_stems),
      caption  = "Vertical jitter is for legibility only and carries no meaning"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11)
  print(p_dist)

  # Cumulative view: what proportion of slices had settled by iteration k?
  # This is the plot that answers the iteration-budget question directly.
  p_ecdf <- ggplot(conv_min_iter, aes(min_iter, colour = origin)) +
    stat_ecdf(linewidth = 0.7) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(original = "#2166AC", refit = "#B2182B"),
                        name = "Ellipse origin") +
    scale_y_continuous(name = "Proportion of slices settled", limits = c(0, 1)) +
    scale_x_continuous(name = "Iteration") +
    labs(title = "Cumulative attainment of the final hypothesis") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11)
  print(p_ecdf)

} else if (!isTRUE(run_conv_diag)) {
  cat("\nRANSAC convergence diagnostic SKIPPED (run_conv_diag = FALSE).\n")
}
```

## 1.5 Temporal Pairing

```{r}
#| label: params-temporal-pairing
#| code-summary: "Parameters - Temporal pairing: Manual (CSV) or triangle correspondence -> pairs_matched"

# ── Triangle-pairing parameters (spatial mode) ────────────────────────────────
tri_band            <- 2.0    # m above each stem's base to average the position
tri_k               <- 20L    # neighbours per stem
tri_side_tol        <- 1.00   # m: max per-side difference for a candidate match
tri_loss_limit      <- 3L     # consecutive assignment losses before outlier drop
tri_max_transforms  <- NULL   # cap on candidate transforms scored (NULL = all)
tri_seed            <- 7L

# How a candidate correspondence is SCORED.
#   "mosaic"  (default) grow a patch of mutually consistent triangles outward
#             from each candidate and score it by how many triangles the patch
#             holds. Nothing is fitted, so nothing can be fitted wrongly.
#   "rmse"    the previous behaviour: fit a rigid transform from the single
#             best-matching triangle pair, apply it to every stem, and score by
#             all-stem pairing RMSE. Kept so an earlier run can be reproduced.
tri_score_mode      <- "mosaic"

# mosaic only. Candidates per epoch-1 triangle: the fan-out of the search.
# Raising it admits more true correspondences in a plot of near-identical
# spacing, at a roughly linear cost in island growth.
tri_cand_max_per_tri <- 10L

# mosaic only. How many seeds to grow from, lowest side residual first. Seeds
# already absorbed by an earlier island are skipped, so this is a ceiling on
# work rather than on islands found. NULL = every candidate.
tri_seed_max         <- 200L

# mosaic only. Refuse a winning island smaller than this. Two or three
# triangles agreeing is within reach of coincidence; a dozen is not. Failing
# loudly beats handing Stage 2 a pairing built on nothing.
tri_min_island       <- 1L

.par_apply("params-temporal-pairing")
```

```{r}
#| label: temporal-pairing
#| code-summary: "Temporal pairing: Manual (CSV) or triangle correspondence -> pairs_matched"

# ── 1.3.1: Core Pairing Logic ────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Produces `pairs_matched`. Nothing in this workflow mutates a pair list in
# place: each filtering step creates a newly named object instead.
#
# CSV mode (use_csv_pairs = TRUE) reads a manual mapping unchanged. Spatial mode
# (FALSE) uses TRIANGLE CORRESPONDENCE, not nearest-neighbour: stem positions are
# taken from the bottom-2 m ellipse centres, small triangles are built over each
# stem and its neighbours, congruent triangles are matched between epochs, and
# the triangle correspondence that - after a rigid fit of las_1 onto las_2 -
# yields the lowest all-stem pairing RMSE decides the final pairs. The fit itself
# is discarded; Stage 2 onward solves the transform properly.

# ============================================================
# 1.3.1a  Triangle-pairing helpers (spatial mode only)
# ============================================================

# Stem position = mean XYZ of the kept ellipse centres within `band` m of the
# stem's lowest kept centre. No projection. Returns one row per stem with a
# position, dropping stems with no kept centres.
.tri_stem_positions <- function(valid_list, band = 2.0) {
  rows <- lapply(names(valid_list), function(tid) {
    df <- valid_list[[tid]]
    if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0L) return(NULL)
    df <- df[!is.na(df$center_x) & !is.na(df$center_y) & !is.na(df$slice_z), , drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(df) == 0L) return(NULL)
    z0 <- min(df$slice_z)
    b  <- df[df$slice_z <= z0 + band + 1e-9, , drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(b) == 0L) return(NULL)
    data.frame(TreeID = as.integer(tid),
               X = mean(b$center_x), Y = mean(b$center_y), Z = mean(b$slice_z),
               n_used = nrow(b), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  })
  out <- do.call(rbind, rows)
  rownames(out) <- NULL
  out
}

# k nearest OTHER stems (3-D Euclidean), as row indices into `pos`.
.tri_neighbours <- function(pos, k = 20L) {
  M  <- as.matrix(pos[, c("X", "Y", "Z")])
  n  <- nrow(M)
  kk <- min(k, n - 1L)
  lapply(seq_len(n), function(i) {
    d <- sqrt(rowSums((M - matrix(M[i, ], n, 3, byrow = TRUE))^2))
    d[i] <- Inf
    order(d)[seq_len(kk)]
  })
}

# Unique triangles: each is the focal stem plus two of its neighbours. A triple
# reached from more than one focal stem is kept once (dedup on the sorted index
# triple).
.tri_build <- function(pos, nb) {
  n <- nrow(pos)
  seen <- new.env(hash = TRUE, parent = emptyenv())
  out  <- vector("list", 0L)
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    ni <- nb[[i]]
    if (length(ni) < 2L) next
    cb <- utils::combn(ni, 2L)
    for (cc in seq_len(ncol(cb))) {
      trio <- c(i, cb[1, cc], cb[2, cc])
      key  <- paste(sort(trio), collapse = "-")
      if (!is.null(seen[[key]])) next
      seen[[key]] <- TRUE
      out[[length(out) + 1L]] <- trio
    }
  }
  out
}

# Canonical a/b/c labelling and sorted side lengths for every triangle.
#   a = vertex opposite the LONGEST side
#   b = vertex on the LONGEST and SHORTEST sides
#   c = vertex on the LONGEST and MIDDLE sides
# so that len_ab = shortest, len_ac = middle, len_bc = longest, giving an
# order-invariant signature. Returns a data frame keyed by tri_id.
.tri_sides <- function(pos, tris) {
  M   <- as.matrix(pos[, c("X", "Y", "Z")])
  ids <- pos$TreeID
  if (length(tris) == 0L)
    return(data.frame(tri_id = integer(0), a = integer(0), b = integer(0), c = integer(0),
                      len_ab = numeric(0), len_ac = numeric(0), len_bc = numeric(0)))
  do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(tris), function(t) {
    v  <- tris[[t]]
    p1 <- M[v[1], ]; p2 <- M[v[2], ]; p3 <- M[v[3], ]
    s_opp <- c(sqrt(sum((p2 - p3)^2)),   # side opposite vertex 1
               sqrt(sum((p1 - p3)^2)),   # opposite vertex 2
               sqrt(sum((p1 - p2)^2)))   # opposite vertex 3
    o  <- order(s_opp)                   # ascending; ties broken by index -> a full permutation
    ic <- o[1]                           # c: opposite the shortest side
    ib <- o[2]                           # b: the remaining vertex
    ia <- o[3]                           # a: opposite the longest side
    data.frame(tri_id = t,
               a = ids[v[ia]], b = ids[v[ib]], c = ids[v[ic]],
               len_ab = s_opp[ic],        # a-b side is opposite c (shortest)
               len_ac = s_opp[ib],        # a-c side is opposite b (middle)
               len_bc = s_opp[ia],        # b-c side is opposite a (longest)
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))
}

# Rigid transform (rotation + translation) mapping the 3 rows of P onto Q by
# Kabsch. Reflections are disallowed (det forced to +1).
.tri_kabsch <- function(P, Q) {
  cP <- colMeans(P); cQ <- colMeans(Q)
  Pc <- sweep(P, 2, cP); Qc <- sweep(Q, 2, cQ)
  H  <- t(Pc) %*% Qc
  sv <- svd(H)
  dsign <- sign(det(sv$v %*% t(sv$u)))
  if (dsign == 0) dsign <- 1
  R <- sv$v %*% diag(c(1, 1, dsign)) %*% t(sv$u)
  list(R = R, t = as.numeric(cQ - R %*% cP))
}

# Unique nearest-stem assignment las_1 -> las_2 from a distance matrix D
# (n1 x n2). Conflicts are resolved by keeping the closer claimant; the loser
# advances to its next-nearest choice. A stem that loses `loss_limit` times in a
# row is dropped as an outlier. Returns the pairing and its RMSE.
.tri_resolve <- function(D, ids1, ids2, loss_limit = 3L) {
  n1 <- nrow(D); n2 <- ncol(D)
  pref   <- lapply(seq_len(n1), function(i) order(D[i, ]))
  ptr    <- rep(1L, n1)
  streak <- rep(0L, n1)
  active <- rep(TRUE, n1)
  cur    <- vapply(seq_len(n1), function(i) pref[[i]][1L], integer(1))

  repeat {
    live <- which(active)
    if (length(live) == 0L) break
    cj <- cur[live]
    dup <- unique(cj[duplicated(cj)])
    if (length(dup) == 0L) break
    changed <- FALSE
    for (j in dup) {
      claimants <- live[cj == j]
      winner    <- claimants[which.min(D[cbind(claimants, rep(j, length(claimants)))])]
      losers    <- setdiff(claimants, winner)
      streak[winner] <- 0L
      for (i in losers) {
        streak[i] <- streak[i] + 1L
        ptr[i]    <- ptr[i] + 1L
        if (streak[i] >= loss_limit || ptr[i] > n2) {
          active[i] <- FALSE
        } else {
          cur[i] <- pref[[i]][ptr[i]]
        }
        changed <- TRUE
      }
    }
    if (!changed) break
  }

  keep <- which(active)
  if (length(keep) == 0L)
    return(list(pairs = data.frame(TreeID_1 = integer(0), TreeID_2 = integer(0),
                                   pair_dist = numeric(0)), rmse = Inf, n = 0L))
  dists <- D[cbind(keep, cur[keep])]
  list(pairs = data.frame(TreeID_1 = ids1[keep],
                          TreeID_2 = ids2[cur[keep]],
                          pair_dist = round(dists, 4),
                          stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
       rmse = sqrt(mean(dists^2)),
       n = length(keep))
}


# ============================================================
# 1.3.1b  Mosaic growth (tri_score_mode = "mosaic")
# ============================================================
# The old scorer fitted a rigid transform from ONE candidate triangle pair,
# applied it to every stem, and scored the result by all-stem RMSE. That asks a
# single triangle to speak for the whole plot: a triangle sitting on a badly
# reconstructed stem gives a bad transform, and RMSE - being an average over
# assignments the bad transform itself produced - can look respectable while the
# pairing underneath is wrong.
#
# Mosaic growth scores a correspondence by how much AGREEMENT it can accumulate.
# Two triangle correspondences are neighbours when they share an EDGE: two of
# the three stem-to-stem pairs, identical in both. Starting from one
# correspondence and repeatedly accepting neighbours that do not contradict what
# has been accepted, a patch of mutually consistent triangles grows outward
# across the plot. The score is the number of triangles in that patch.
#
# What makes this stronger than RMSE: a wrong correspondence has no reason to
# have neighbours. For it to grow, other independently congruent triangles must
# agree with it stem for stem, which coincidence does not supply at any size.
# No transform is fitted at any point, so no fit can be wrong - the geometry
# enters only as the congruence test that produced the candidates.

#' Every congruent epoch-2 triangle for every epoch-1 triangle (not just the best).
#'
#' The old code kept one candidate per epoch-1 triangle - the lowest side
#' residual. Mosaic growth needs them all: the correct correspondence is
#' routinely not the closest on side lengths alone, and it is agreement, not
#' closeness, that identifies it.
#'
#' `max_per_tri` caps the fan-out per epoch-1 triangle (keeping the lowest
#' residuals) so a plot of near-identical spacing cannot explode the candidate
#' set.
.tri_candidates <- function(sides_1, sides_2, tol, max_per_tri = 10L) {
  ord2 <- order(sides_2$len_bc)
  s2   <- sides_2[ord2, , drop = FALSE]
  bc2  <- s2$len_bc; ab2 <- s2$len_ab; ac2 <- s2$len_ac

  i_out <- integer(0); j_out <- integer(0); r_out <- numeric(0)
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(sides_1))) {
    lo <- findInterval(sides_1$len_bc[i] - tol, bc2) + 1L
    hi <- findInterval(sides_1$len_bc[i] + tol, bc2)
    if (hi < lo) next
    idx <- lo:hi
    ok  <- abs(ab2[idx] - sides_1$len_ab[i]) <= tol &
           abs(ac2[idx] - sides_1$len_ac[i]) <= tol
    if (!any(ok)) next
    idx <- idx[ok]
    rr  <- sqrt(((ab2[idx] - sides_1$len_ab[i])^2 +
                 (ac2[idx] - sides_1$len_ac[i])^2 +
                 (bc2[idx] - sides_1$len_bc[i])^2) / 3)
    if (length(idx) > max_per_tri) {
      keep <- order(rr)[seq_len(max_per_tri)]
      idx <- idx[keep]; rr <- rr[keep]
    }
    i_out <- c(i_out, rep(i, length(idx)))
    j_out <- c(j_out, idx)
    r_out <- c(r_out, rr)
  }
  list(i = i_out, j = j_out, resid = r_out, s2 = s2)
}

#' Grow one island outward from a seed correspondence.
#'
#' Accepts a neighbouring correspondence only if every stem-to-stem pair it
#' brings is either already in the island exactly as it stands, or maps two
#' stems neither of which is already spoken for. That conflict test is what
#' keeps an island a single coherent reading of the plot: without it, two
#' incompatible mappings joined by one ambiguous triangle would merge into a
#' meaningless super-island and win on size.
#'
#' Returns the accepted correspondence indices and the mapping they agree on.
.tri_grow_island <- function(seed, cand_pairs, edge_index, edges_of) {
  acc  <- new.env(hash = TRUE, parent = emptyenv())   # accepted candidate ids
  m1   <- new.env(hash = TRUE, parent = emptyenv())   # TreeID_1 -> TreeID_2
  m2   <- new.env(hash = TRUE, parent = emptyenv())   # TreeID_2 -> TreeID_1

  .fits <- function(k) {
    pr <- cand_pairs[[k]]
    for (p in seq_len(3L)) {
      t1 <- pr$t1[p]; t2 <- pr$t2[p]
      e1 <- m1[[t1]]; e2 <- m2[[t2]]
      if (!is.null(e1) && !identical(e1, t2)) return(FALSE)
      if (!is.null(e2) && !identical(e2, t1)) return(FALSE)
    }
    TRUE
  }
```
