```{r}
  .absorb <- function(k) {
    pr <- cand_pairs[[k]]
    for (p in seq_len(3L)) { m1[[pr$t1[p]]] <- pr$t2[p]; m2[[pr$t2[p]]] <- pr$t1[p] }
    acc[[as.character(k)]] <- TRUE
  }

  if (!.fits(seed)) return(NULL)
  .absorb(seed)
  frontier <- edges_of[[seed]]

  while (length(frontier)) {
    e <- frontier[[1L]]; frontier <- frontier[-1L]
    nb <- edge_index[[e]]
    if (is.null(nb)) next
    for (k in nb) {
      if (!is.null(acc[[as.character(k)]])) next
      if (!.fits(k)) next
      .absorb(k)
      frontier <- c(frontier, edges_of[[k]])
    }
  }

  ids <- as.integer(ls(acc))
  list(cands = ids,
       pairs = data.frame(TreeID_1 = as.integer(ls(m1)),
                          TreeID_2 = as.integer(unlist(mget(ls(m1), envir = m1))),
                          stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
}


if (use_csv_pairs) {
  # --- CASE A: CSV MANUAL MAPPING ---
  cat("Mode: Using CSV for temporal pairing...\n")
  
  pairs_raw_file <- read.csv(pairs_csv_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  
  # Map CSV columns to internal naming convention
  pairs_matched <- data.frame(
    TreeID_1  = pairs_raw_file[[col_treeid_las1]],
    TreeID_2  = pairs_raw_file[[col_treeid_las2]],
    pair_dist = NA_real_ # Distance isn't calculated for manual CSV pairs
  )
  
  # Remove any pairs where the ID doesn't actually exist in the processed lists
  exists_1 <- pairs_matched$TreeID_1 %in% names(ellipses_zt_1_valid_all)
  exists_2 <- pairs_matched$TreeID_2 %in% names(ellipses_zt_2_valid_all)
  pairs_matched <- pairs_matched[exists_1 & exists_2, ]
  
  cat(sprintf("Loaded %d temporal pairs from CSV.\n", nrow(pairs_matched)))

} else {
  # --- CASE B: TRIANGLE CORRESPONDENCE ---
  cat("Mode: Triangle-correspondence temporal pairing...\n")
  set.seed(tri_seed)

  # Prefer the post-refit (pass-2) kept ellipses; fall back to pass-1 valid.
  .vl1 <- if (exists("ellipses_zt_1_valid2_all")) ellipses_zt_1_valid2_all else ellipses_zt_1_valid_all
  .vl2 <- if (exists("ellipses_zt_2_valid2_all")) ellipses_zt_2_valid2_all else ellipses_zt_2_valid_all

  # ── Step 1: stem-position maps (bottom tri_band m), one row per stem ──────────
  pos_1 <- .tri_stem_positions(.vl1, band = tri_band)
  pos_2 <- .tri_stem_positions(.vl2, band = tri_band)
  if (is.null(pos_1) || nrow(pos_1) < 3L || is.null(pos_2) || nrow(pos_2) < 3L)
    stop("Triangle pairing needs at least 3 positioned stems per epoch.")

  cat(sprintf("Stem positions - las_1: %d | las_2: %d (bottom %.1f m)\n",
              nrow(pos_1), nrow(pos_2), tri_band))

  P1 <- as.matrix(pos_1[, c("X", "Y", "Z")]); rownames(P1) <- as.character(pos_1$TreeID)
  P2 <- as.matrix(pos_2[, c("X", "Y", "Z")]); rownames(P2) <- as.character(pos_2$TreeID)

  # ── Steps 2-7: neighbours -> triangles -> canonical sides, per epoch ──────────
  tris_1  <- .tri_build(pos_1, .tri_neighbours(pos_1, k = tri_k))
  tris_2  <- .tri_build(pos_2, .tri_neighbours(pos_2, k = tri_k))
  sides_1 <- .tri_sides(pos_1, tris_1)
  sides_2 <- .tri_sides(pos_2, tris_2)
  cat(sprintf("Unique triangles - las_1: %d | las_2: %d\n",
              nrow(sides_1), nrow(sides_2)))

  if (identical(tri_score_mode, "mosaic")) {

    # ── Step 8m.1: every congruent correspondence, not just the best ──────────
    cc <- .tri_candidates(sides_1, sides_2, tol = tri_side_tol,
                          max_per_tri = tri_cand_max_per_tri)
    s2 <- cc$s2
    n_cand <- length(cc$i)
    if (n_cand == 0L)
      stop("Triangle pairing: no congruent triangle pairs within tri_side_tol - loosen the tolerance.")
    cat(sprintf("Candidate correspondences: %d (from %d epoch-1 triangles, <= %d each)\n",
                n_cand, length(unique(cc$i)), tri_cand_max_per_tri))

    # ── Step 8m.2: each correspondence as three stem-to-stem pairs ────────────
    # Vertex roles carry the orientation: a matches a, b matches b, c matches c,
    # under the canonical labelling both epochs were given. Two correspondences
    # over the same three stems in a DIFFERENT arrangement are different
    # candidates, and cannot join the same island - which is the point.
    cand_pairs <- vector("list", n_cand)
    edges_of   <- vector("list", n_cand)
    edge_index <- new.env(hash = TRUE, parent = emptyenv())
    for (k in seq_len(n_cand)) {
      i <- cc$i[k]; j <- cc$j[k]
      t1 <- as.character(c(sides_1$a[i], sides_1$b[i], sides_1$c[i]))
      t2 <- as.character(c(s2$a[j],      s2$b[j],      s2$c[j]))
      cand_pairs[[k]] <- list(t1 = t1, t2 = t2)
      pk <- paste0(t1, "|", t2)                       # the three pair keys
      ek <- c(paste(sort(pk[c(1, 2)]), collapse = "/"),
              paste(sort(pk[c(1, 3)]), collapse = "/"),
              paste(sort(pk[c(2, 3)]), collapse = "/"))
      edges_of[[k]] <- ek
      for (e in ek) edge_index[[e]] <- c(edge_index[[e]], k)
    }
    cat(sprintf("Shared edges (2 stem-pairs in common): %d\n", length(ls(edge_index))))

    # ── Step 8m.3: grow an island from each seed, keep the largest ────────────
    # Seeds are tried in order of side residual - not because the residual
    # decides anything, but because a good seed grows its island early and the
    # skip below then removes hundreds of redundant seeds from inside it.
    seed_order <- order(cc$resid)
    if (!is.null(tri_seed_max) && length(seed_order) > tri_seed_max)
      seed_order <- seed_order[seq_len(tri_seed_max)]

    seen_in_island <- logical(n_cand)
    best <- NULL; best_n <- 0L; best_resid <- Inf; n_grown <- 0L

    # No on.exit() here: this runs at chunk top level, not inside a function,
    # so there is no frame to register against. .pb_done is called below.
    .pb_isl <- .pb_new(length(seed_order), "temporal pairing: islands")

    for (s in seed_order) {
      .pb_tick(.pb_isl)
      # A seed already absorbed by an earlier island would regrow that same
      # island. Skipping it is what keeps this affordable; it costs nothing,
      # because an island is the same set whichever of its members seeds it.
      if (seen_in_island[s]) next
      isl <- .tri_grow_island(s, cand_pairs, edge_index, edges_of)
      if (is.null(isl)) next
      n_grown <- n_grown + 1L
      seen_in_island[isl$cands] <- TRUE
      n_tri <- length(isl$cands)
      mr    <- mean(cc$resid[isl$cands])
      # Size decides. The mean side residual breaks ties only - two islands of
      # equal size are equally well supported, and then the tighter congruence
      # is the better guess.
      if (n_tri > best_n || (n_tri == best_n && mr < best_resid)) {
        best <- isl; best_n <- n_tri; best_resid <- mr
      }
    }
    .pb_done(.pb_isl)

    if (is.null(best) || best_n < tri_min_island)
      stop(sprintf(paste0("Triangle pairing: the largest consistent island holds %d triangle(s), ",
                          "below tri_min_island = %d.\n",
                          "  Either the two epochs share too little structure, or tri_side_tol ",
                          "(%.2f m) is too tight to admit the true correspondences."),
                   best_n, tri_min_island, tri_side_tol))

    # ── Step 8m.4: pairs, with the island's own support per pair ─────────────
    # support = how many triangles of the winning island contain this pair. A
    # pair carried by twenty triangles is corroborated twenty ways; one carried
    # by a single triangle sits on the island's edge and is the first thing to
    # doubt. Stage 2's IRLS filter reads none of this - it is here to be looked
    # at when a pairing seems wrong.
    pair_support <- table(unlist(lapply(best$cands, function(k)
      paste0(cand_pairs[[k]]$t1, "|", cand_pairs[[k]]$t2))))
    pk <- paste0(best$pairs$TreeID_1, "|", best$pairs$TreeID_2)
    best$pairs$support <- as.integer(pair_support[pk])

    # A rigid fit over the WHOLE island, purely to report a per-pair residual in
    # the pair_dist column the rest of the workflow expects. It scores nothing -
    # the island was chosen before this ran - and Stage 2 solves the transform
    # properly from the stem axes.
    .kp <- best$pairs
    .P  <- P1[as.character(.kp$TreeID_1), , drop = FALSE]
    .Q  <- P2[as.character(.kp$TreeID_2), , drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(.kp) >= 3L) {
      .kb  <- .tri_kabsch(.P, .Q)
      .Pt  <- sweep(.P %*% t(.kb$R), 2, .kb$t, "+")
      .kp$pair_dist <- round(sqrt(rowSums((.Pt - .Q)^2)), 4)
    } else {
      .kp$pair_dist <- NA_real_
    }

    pairs_matched <- .kp[order(-.kp$support), c("TreeID_1", "TreeID_2", "pair_dist", "support")]
    rownames(pairs_matched) <- NULL

    cat(sprintf("\nMosaic pairing complete: %d pair(s) from an island of %d triangle(s).\n",
                nrow(pairs_matched), best_n))
    cat(sprintf("  islands grown: %d from %d seed(s) | winning island mean side residual %.4f m\n",
                n_grown, length(seed_order), best_resid))
    cat(sprintf("  per-pair support: median %.0f | min %d | pairs supported by one triangle: %d\n",
                stats::median(pairs_matched$support), min(pairs_matched$support),
                sum(pairs_matched$support == 1L)))
    if (any(!is.na(pairs_matched$pair_dist)))
      cat(sprintf("  (reporting only) rigid fit over the island: median residual %.4f m | max %.4f m\n",
                  stats::median(pairs_matched$pair_dist), max(pairs_matched$pair_dist)))

  } else {

  # ── Step 8.1-8.2: best epoch-2 candidate per epoch-1 triangle ─────────────────
  # A candidate must match on all three canonical sides within tri_side_tol; the
  # best is the one with the lowest RMSE of the three side residuals. A bc-range
  # pre-filter keeps the search near-linear in the number of triangles.
  ord2   <- order(sides_2$len_bc)
  s2     <- sides_2[ord2, , drop = FALSE]
  bc2    <- s2$len_bc; ab2 <- s2$len_ab; ac2 <- s2$len_ac

  best_j    <- integer(nrow(sides_1))
  best_rmse <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(sides_1))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(sides_1))) {
    lo <- findInterval(sides_1$len_bc[i] - tri_side_tol, bc2) + 1L
    hi <- findInterval(sides_1$len_bc[i] + tri_side_tol, bc2)
    if (hi < lo) next
    idx <- lo:hi
    ok  <- abs(ab2[idx] - sides_1$len_ab[i]) <= tri_side_tol &
           abs(ac2[idx] - sides_1$len_ac[i]) <= tri_side_tol
    if (!any(ok)) next
    idx <- idx[ok]
    rr  <- sqrt(((ab2[idx] - sides_1$len_ab[i])^2 +
                 (ac2[idx] - sides_1$len_ac[i])^2 +
                 (bc2[idx] - sides_1$len_bc[i])^2) / 3)
    w   <- which.min(rr)
    best_j[i]    <- idx[w]           # row index into s2 (bc-sorted)
    best_rmse[i] <- rr[w]
  }

  cand <- which(best_j > 0L)
  if (length(cand) == 0L)
    stop("Triangle pairing: no congruent triangle pairs within tri_side_tol - loosen the tolerance.")
  cat(sprintf("Epoch-1 triangles with a congruent match: %d of %d\n",
              length(cand), nrow(sides_1)))

  # Rank candidate transforms by triangle-side RMSE, optionally capped.
  cand <- cand[order(best_rmse[cand])]
  if (!is.null(tri_max_transforms) && length(cand) > tri_max_transforms)
    cand <- cand[seq_len(tri_max_transforms)]

  # ── Step 8.3-8.4: score each candidate transform by all-stem pairing RMSE ─────
  ids1_all <- pos_1$TreeID
  best_score <- Inf
  best_pairs <- NULL
  best_meta  <- NULL
  .prog <- max(1L, floor(length(cand) / 10L))

  for (m in seq_along(cand)) {
    i  <- cand[m]
    j  <- best_j[i]                       # row in s2 (bc-sorted)
    # 3-vertex correspondence a<->a, b<->b, c<->c
    P  <- rbind(P1[as.character(sides_1$a[i]), ],
                P1[as.character(sides_1$b[i]), ],
                P1[as.character(sides_1$c[i]), ])
    Q  <- rbind(P2[as.character(s2$a[j]), ],
                P2[as.character(s2$b[j]), ],
                P2[as.character(s2$c[j]), ])
    kb <- .tri_kabsch(P, Q)

    # Apply the temporary transform to EVERY las_1 stem position.
    P1t <- P1 %*% t(kb$R)
    P1t <- sweep(P1t, 2, kb$t, "+")

    # Distances from every transformed las_1 stem to every las_2 stem.
    D <- sqrt(
      outer(P1t[, 1], P2[, 1], "-")^2 +
      outer(P1t[, 2], P2[, 2], "-")^2 +
      outer(P1t[, 3], P2[, 3], "-")^2
    )

    rr <- .tri_resolve(D, ids1_all, pos_2$TreeID, loss_limit = tri_loss_limit)
    if (rr$n > 0L && rr$rmse < best_score) {
      best_score <- rr$rmse
      best_pairs <- rr$pairs
      best_meta  <- c(tri1 = i, tri2 = j, n_pairs = rr$n)
    }
    if (m %% .prog == 0L)
      cat(sprintf("  scored %d / %d transforms | best RMSE %.4f m (%d pairs)\n",
                  m, length(cand), best_score,
                  if (is.null(best_pairs)) 0L else nrow(best_pairs)))
  }

  if (is.null(best_pairs) || nrow(best_pairs) == 0L)
    stop("Triangle pairing: no transform produced a usable pairing.")

  # The transform is deliberately NOT kept - only the pairing it induced.
  pairs_matched <- best_pairs[, c("TreeID_1", "TreeID_2", "pair_dist")]
  pairs_matched$TreeID_1 <- as.integer(pairs_matched$TreeID_1)
  pairs_matched$TreeID_2 <- as.integer(pairs_matched$TreeID_2)

  cat(sprintf(
    "\nTriangle pairing complete: %d pair(s) from the winning transform (all-stem RMSE %.4f m).\n",
    nrow(pairs_matched), best_score))
  cat(sprintf("  winning triangle: las_1 tri %d <-> las_2 tri %d\n",
              best_meta["tri1"], best_meta["tri2"]))
  }
}

# ── 1.3.2: Unified Summary & DBH Records ─────────────────────────────────────
# This block runs regardless of whether use_csv_pairs was TRUE or FALSE

# Small helper: number of kept (valid, post-cleaning) ellipse rows for a
# given TreeID, looked up from a $valid list (ellipses_zt_*_valid_all).
get_n_kept_ellipses <- function(tid, valid_list) {
  tid_chr <- as.character(tid)
  if (is.null(tid_chr) || is.na(tid_chr) || !tid_chr %in% names(valid_list)) {
    return(NA_integer_)
  }
  df <- valid_list[[tid_chr]]
  if (is.null(df)) return(NA_integer_)
  nrow(df)
}

unpaired_1 <- names(ellipses_zt_1_valid_all)[!names(ellipses_zt_1_valid_all) %in% as.character(pairs_matched$TreeID_1)]
unpaired_1 <- as.integer(unpaired_1)

pair_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  # Statistics for paired trees
  pairs_matched |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      `average diameter 1` = sapply(TreeID_1, get_avg_diam_valid,
                                    valid_list = ellipses_zt_1_valid_all),
      `average diameter 2` = sapply(TreeID_2, get_avg_diam_valid,
                                    valid_list = ellipses_zt_2_valid_all),
      `delta diameter`     = `average diameter 2` - `average diameter 1`,
      n_ellipses_1          = sapply(TreeID_1, get_n_kept_ellipses,
                                    valid_list = ellipses_zt_1_valid_all),
      n_ellipses_2          = sapply(TreeID_2, get_n_kept_ellipses,
                                    valid_list = ellipses_zt_2_valid_all),
      n_removed_xy_1       = sapply(TreeID_1, get_clean_stat,
                                    results_list = clean_results_1_all,
                                    stat = "n_removed_xy"),
      prop_kept_1          = sapply(TreeID_1, get_clean_stat,
                                    results_list = clean_results_1_all,
                                    stat = "prop_kept"),
      mean_p_stem_1        = sapply(TreeID_1, get_clean_stat,
                                    results_list = clean_results_1_all,
                                    stat = "mean_p_stem"),
      n_removed_xy_2       = sapply(TreeID_2, get_clean_stat,
                                    results_list = clean_results_2_all,
                                    stat = "n_removed_xy"),
      prop_kept_2          = sapply(TreeID_2, get_clean_stat,
                                    results_list = clean_results_2_all,
                                    stat = "prop_kept"),
      mean_p_stem_2        = sapply(TreeID_2, get_clean_stat,
                                    results_list = clean_results_2_all,
                                    stat = "mean_p_stem")
    ),
  # Statistics for unpaired trees in las_1
  if (length(unpaired_1) > 0)
    data.frame(
      TreeID_1             = unpaired_1,
      TreeID_2             = NA_integer_,
      pair_dist            = NA_real_,
      `average diameter 1` = sapply(unpaired_1, get_avg_diam_valid,
                                    valid_list = ellipses_zt_1_valid_all),
      `average diameter 2` = NA_real_,
      `delta diameter`     = NA_real_,
      n_ellipses_1          = sapply(unpaired_1, get_n_kept_ellipses,
                                    valid_list = ellipses_zt_1_valid_all),
      n_ellipses_2          = NA_integer_,
      n_removed_xy_1       = sapply(unpaired_1, get_clean_stat,
                                    results_list = clean_results_1_all,
                                    stat = "n_removed_xy"),
      prop_kept_1          = sapply(unpaired_1, get_clean_stat,
                                    results_list = clean_results_1_all,
                                    stat = "prop_kept"),
      mean_p_stem_1        = sapply(unpaired_1, get_clean_stat,
                                    results_list = clean_results_1_all,
                                    stat = "mean_p_stem"),
      n_removed_xy_2       = NA_real_,
      prop_kept_2          = NA_real_,
      mean_p_stem_2        = NA_real_,
      check.names          = FALSE
    )
  else NULL
)

# ── 1.3.3: Final Reporting ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

cat(sprintf("\nFinal paired trees for alignment: %d\n", nrow(pairs_matched)))
cat("Kept temporal pairs details:\n")
paired_print <- pair_summary[!is.na(pair_summary$TreeID_2), ]
paired_print <- paired_print[order(paired_print$TreeID_1), ]
print(as.data.frame(paired_print), row.names = FALSE)

if (length(unpaired_1) > 0)
  cat(sprintf("\nUnpaired las_1 trees (skipped in alignment): %s\n", 
              paste(sort(unpaired_1), collapse = ", ")))

cat(sprintf("\nDownstream use: %d valid pairs available.\n", nrow(pairs_matched)))

# `pairs_matched` is the raw output of the pairing step above. `pairs_stage1`
# is the frozen Stage 1 result that Stage 2 consumes. They are identical at
# this point – the separate name exists so that the two roles never collide if
# the pairing chunk is re-run, and so that every downstream pair list can be
# traced back through an unbroken chain of distinctly named objects.
#
# (The former "Manual Error Pair Removal" step has been removed from Stage 1;
# outlier pairs are now dropped objectively by the Stage 2 IRLS residual filter
# and the Stage 3 coverage filters.)

pairs_stage1 <- pairs_matched

cat(sprintf("pairs_stage1: %d temporal pair(s) carried into Stage 2.\n",
            nrow(pairs_stage1)))
.tally(n_pairs_original = nrow(pairs_stage1))
print(utils::head(pairs_stage1, 10))
```


### Vis - 3D stem with ellipses & inliers

```{r}
#| label: params-fig-ransac-inliers-3d-raw
#| code-summary: "Parameters - fig-ransac-inliers-3d-raw"


vis_all_paired_trees <- TRUE
vis_selected_tids_1  <- c(1, 2)
vis_pad              <- 0.10    # m of headroom above/below the fitted window
vis_pts_per_slice    <- 200L    # inlier points sampled per fitted slice
vis_pts_per_tree     <- 1000L   # non-inlier points kept per tree
vis_ring_n_pts       <- 120L
vis_verbose          <- TRUE

.par_apply("params-fig-ransac-inliers-3d-raw")
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-ransac-inliers-3d-raw
#| fig-cap: "Raw RANSAC inliers with fitted ellipse rings – paired trees only."

if (vis_all_paired_trees) {
  vis_pairs <- pairs_stage1
} else {
  vis_pairs <- pairs_stage1[pairs_stage1$TreeID_1 %in% vis_selected_tids_1, ]
  if (nrow(vis_pairs) == 0L)
    warning("[vis] None of vis_selected_tids_1 matched pairs_stage1$TreeID_1 – nothing to plot.")
}

# ── Z-window convention ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# vis_z_min / vis_z_max are HEIGHTS ABOVE A REFERENCE, not absolute Z – the same
# convention as ransac_slice_bot / ransac_slice_top, which the fitter applies as
#   bot_i <- z_min_tree + bot
# Reference per tree:
#   second_run = TRUE   -> that pair's shared_plane (both epochs share a band)
#   second_run = FALSE  -> the tree's own lowest point
# slice_z, and therefore the ring geometry, stays absolute Z throughout.
vis_z_min <- if (is.null(ransac_slice_bot)) 0   else ransac_slice_bot - vis_pad
vis_z_max <- if (is.null(ransac_slice_top)) Inf else ransac_slice_top + vis_pad

# Plane lookup for a tree, by cloud – NULL outside second_run
.vis_plane <- function(tid, tid_col) {
  if (!second_run || !exists("pair_planes")) return(NULL)
  row <- pair_planes[pair_planes[[tid_col]] == tid, ]
  if (nrow(row) > 0L) row$shared_plane[1L] else NULL
}

# ── Collect windowed, inlier-labelled points for one cloud ───────────────────
collect_inlier_pts <- function(las, ellipses_all, tids, cloud_label, tid_col) {
  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(tids, function(tid) {

    .skip <- function(why) {
      if (vis_verbose) cat(sprintf("[vis] %s tree %s: %s\n", cloud_label, tid, why))
      NULL
    }

    tree_df <- ellipses_all[[as.character(tid)]]
    if (is.null(tree_df) || nrow(tree_df) == 0L) return(.skip("no ellipse record"))

    # !is.na() first: a bare `TreeID == tid` yields NA on any point whose TreeID
    # is NA, and a logical index containing NA returns NA-filled ROWS from a
    # data.frame rather than dropping them. sum() would also return NA and the
    # zero-point guard below would never fire.
    idx <- !is.na(las@data$TreeID) & las@data$TreeID == as.integer(tid)
    if (sum(idx) == 0L) return(.skip("no points in cloud"))

    df <- as.data.frame(las@data[idx, c("X", "Y", "Z", "point_id")])

    sp    <- .vis_plane(tid, tid_col)
    z_ref <- if (!is.null(sp)) sp else min(df$Z)
    df    <- df[df$Z >= z_ref + vis_z_min & df$Z <= z_ref + vis_z_max, ]
    if (nrow(df) < 5L)
      return(.skip(sprintf("only %d point(s) in window (z_ref = %.2f)",
                           nrow(df), z_ref)))

    fitted     <- tree_df[!is.na(tree_df$center_x), ]
    inlier_ids <- unique(as.integer(unlist(
      lapply(fitted$inlier_ids, function(ids) {
        if (length(ids) > vis_pts_per_slice) sample(ids, vis_pts_per_slice) else ids
      })
    )))

    df$TreeID <- tid
    df$group  <- ifelse(df$point_id %in% inlier_ids,
                        paste(cloud_label, "inliers"),
                        paste(cloud_label, "other"))

    grey_idx <- which(df$group == paste(cloud_label, "other"))
    if (length(grey_idx) > vis_pts_per_tree)
      df <- df[-grey_idx[sample.int(length(grey_idx),
                                    length(grey_idx) - vis_pts_per_tree)], ]
    df
  }))
}

# ── Rings for a set of trees, clipped to the same window ─────────────────────
collect_rings <- function(las, valid_list, tids, cloud_label, tid_col) {
  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(tids, function(tid) {
    r <- build_pair_rings(valid_list, tid, las, n = vis_ring_n_pts)
    if (is.null(r) || nrow(r) == 0L) return(NULL)

    idx <- las@data$TreeID == as.integer(tid)
    if (sum(idx) == 0L) return(NULL)

    sp    <- .vis_plane(tid, tid_col)
    z_ref <- if (!is.null(sp)) sp else min(las@data$Z[idx])
    r     <- r[r$Z >= z_ref + vis_z_min & r$Z <= z_ref + vis_z_max, ]
    if (nrow(r) == 0L) return(NULL)

    r |> dplyr::mutate(TreeID = tid)
  }))
}

# ── Build the single scene ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
if (params$make_plots && nrow(vis_pairs) > 0L) {

  tids_1 <- vis_pairs$TreeID_1
  tids_2 <- vis_pairs$TreeID_2

  all_pts <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    collect_inlier_pts(las_1, ellipses_zt_1_all, tids_1, "las_1", "TreeID_1"),
    collect_inlier_pts(las_2, ellipses_zt_2_all, tids_2, "las_2", "TreeID_2")
  )

  if (is.null(all_pts) || nrow(all_pts) == 0L) {
    cat("[vis] No points in window – nothing to plot.\n")
  } else {

    # One shared local origin so every stem sits in the same frame.
    cx <- mean(all_pts$X, na.rm = TRUE)
    cy <- mean(all_pts$Y, na.rm = TRUE)
    all_pts <- all_pts |> dplyr::mutate(X_local = X - cx, Y_local = Y - cy)

    rings_1 <- collect_rings(las_1, ellipses_zt_1_valid_all, tids_1, "las_1", "TreeID_1")
    rings_2 <- collect_rings(las_2, ellipses_zt_2_valid_all, tids_2, "las_2", "TreeID_2")

    group_colours <- c(
      "las_1 inliers" = COL_1,
      "las_1 other"   = "grey80",
      "las_2 inliers" = COL_2,
      "las_2 other"   = "grey65"
    )
    group_opacity <- c(
      "las_1 inliers" = 0.75, "las_1 other" = 0.30,
      "las_2 inliers" = 0.75, "las_2 other" = 0.30
    )
    group_order <- names(group_colours)

    p <- plot_ly()

    for (grp in group_order) {
      d <- dplyr::filter(all_pts, group == grp)
      if (nrow(d) == 0L) next
      p <- p |> add_trace(
        data      = d,
        x = ~X_local, y = ~Y_local, z = ~Z,
        type      = "scatter3d", mode = "markers",
        name      = grp, legendgroup = grp,
        marker    = list(size    = 1.6,
                         color   = group_colours[[grp]],
                         opacity = group_opacity[[grp]]),
        text      = ~paste0("TreeID: ", TreeID, "<br>", grp),
        hoverinfo = "text"
      )
    }

    if (!is.null(rings_1) && nrow(rings_1) > 0L) {
      p <- p |> add_trace(
        data       = rings_1 |> dplyr::mutate(X_local = X - cx, Y_local = Y - cy),
        x = ~X_local, y = ~Y_local, z = ~Z,
        type       = "scatter3d", mode = "lines",
        name       = "las_1 ellipses", legendgroup = "las_1 inliers",
        showlegend = FALSE,
        line       = list(color = "purple", width = 2),
        hoverinfo  = "none", inherit = FALSE
      )
    }

    if (!is.null(rings_2) && nrow(rings_2) > 0L) {
      p <- p |> add_trace(
        data       = rings_2 |> dplyr::mutate(X_local = X - cx, Y_local = Y - cy),
        x = ~X_local, y = ~Y_local, z = ~Z,
        type       = "scatter3d", mode = "lines",
        name       = "las_2 ellipses", legendgroup = "las_2 inliers",
        showlegend = FALSE,
        line       = list(color = "darkorange", width = 2),
        hoverinfo  = "none", inherit = FALSE
      )
    }

    if (vis_verbose)
      cat(sprintf("[vis] %d pair(s) -> %d point(s), %d + %d ring vertices.\n",
                  nrow(vis_pairs), nrow(all_pts),
                  if (is.null(rings_1)) 0L else nrow(rings_1),
                  if (is.null(rings_2)) 0L else nrow(rings_2)))

    p |> layout(
      title = "Raw RANSAC inliers with fitted ellipse rings – paired trees",
      scene = list(
        xaxis = list(title = "X local (m)"),
        yaxis = list(title = "Y local (m)"),
        zaxis = list(title = "Z (m)"),
        aspectmode = "data"
      )
    )
  }
}
```


```{r}
#| label: inspect-pairs-mini-3d-fixed
#| fig-cap: "3D inspection of temporal pairs with fitted ellipse rings."

if (vis_all_paired_trees) {
  vis_pairs <- pairs_stage1
} else {
  vis_pairs <- pairs_stage1[pairs_stage1$TreeID_1 %in% vis_selected_tids_1, ]
  if (nrow(vis_pairs) == 0L)
    warning("[vis] None of vis_selected_tids_1 matched pairs_stage1$TreeID_1 – nothing to plot.")
}

# ── Extract points using the actual Z range of the fitted rings ───────────────
# This guarantees points and rings are always co-registered regardless of run
# mode, because the window comes from the rings themselves rather than from any
# independently-computed reference plane.
extract_pts_from_ring_range <- function(las, tid, valid_list,
                                        pad       = 0.05,
                                        max_pts   = 1000L) {
  ell <- valid_list[[as.character(tid)]]
  df  <- as.data.frame(las@data[las@data$TreeID == tid,
                                c("X", "Y", "Z", "TreeID")])
  if (nrow(df) == 0L) return(NULL)

  # Determine window from ring slice_z values when available,
  # otherwise fall back to the global slice parameters (or, if those are
  # NULL/adaptive, to this tree's own full point-cloud height range).
  # slice_z, ransac_slice_bot and ransac_slice_top are all absolute Z values
  # (heights are not re-normalised per tree), so no offset is added back.
  if (!is.null(ell) && nrow(ell) > 0L && "slice_z" %in% names(ell)) {
    z_lo <- min(ell$slice_z, na.rm = TRUE) - pad
    z_hi <- max(ell$slice_z, na.rm = TRUE) + pad
  } else {
    z_lo <- if (is.null(ransac_slice_bot)) min(df$Z) - pad else ransac_slice_bot - pad
    z_hi <- if (is.null(ransac_slice_top)) max(df$Z) + pad else ransac_slice_top + pad
  }

  df <- df[df$Z >= z_lo & df$Z <= z_hi, ]
  if (nrow(df) == 0L) return(NULL)
  if (nrow(df) > max_pts) df <- df[sample.int(nrow(df), max_pts), ]
  df
}

if (params$make_plots && nrow(vis_pairs) > 0L) {

  points_per_tree <- 1000
  ring_n_pts      <- 60L

  plot_list <- vector("list", nrow(vis_pairs))

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(vis_pairs))) {

    tid1 <- vis_pairs$TreeID_1[i]
    tid2 <- vis_pairs$TreeID_2[i]

    df1 <- extract_pts_from_ring_range(las_1, tid1, ellipses_zt_1_valid_all,
                                        max_pts = points_per_tree) |>
      dplyr::mutate(cloud = "las_1")
    df2 <- extract_pts_from_ring_range(las_2, tid2, ellipses_zt_2_valid_all,
                                        max_pts = points_per_tree) |>
      dplyr::mutate(cloud = "las_2")

    df <- dplyr::bind_rows(df1, df2)
    if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) < 20) next

    cx <- mean(df$X); cy <- mean(df$Y)
    df <- df |> dplyr::mutate(X_local = X - cx, Y_local = Y - cy)

    rings1 <- build_pair_rings(ellipses_zt_1_valid_all, tid1, las_1, n = ring_n_pts)
    rings2 <- build_pair_rings(ellipses_zt_2_valid_all, tid2, las_2, n = ring_n_pts)

    p <- plot_ly(
      data = df, x = ~X_local, y = ~Y_local, z = ~Z,
      color     = ~cloud,
      colors    = c("las_1" = COL_1, "las_2" = COL_2),
      type      = "scatter3d", mode = "markers",
      marker    = list(size = 2, opacity = 0.7),
      hoverinfo = "none"
    )

    if (!is.null(rings1) && nrow(rings1) > 0) {
      rings1 <- rings1 |> dplyr::mutate(Xloc = X - cx, Yloc = Y - cy)
      p <- p |> add_trace(
        data = rings1, x = ~Xloc, y = ~Yloc, z = ~Z,
        type = "scatter3d", mode = "lines", name = "ellipses las_1",
        line = list(color = "cyan", width = 2),
        hoverinfo = "none", inherit = FALSE
      )
    }

    if (!is.null(rings2) && nrow(rings2) > 0) {
      rings2 <- rings2 |> dplyr::mutate(Xloc = X - cx, Yloc = Y - cy)
      p <- p |> add_trace(
        data = rings2, x = ~Xloc, y = ~Yloc, z = ~Z,
        type = "scatter3d", mode = "lines", name = "ellipses las_2",
        line = list(color = "gold", width = 2),
        hoverinfo = "none", inherit = FALSE
      )
    }

    plot_list[[i]] <- p |>
      layout(
        title = sprintf("Pair %d: Tree %d (las_1) \u2014 Tree %d (las_2)", i, tid1, tid2),
        scene = list(aspectmode = "data")
      )
  }

  plot_list <- Filter(Negate(is.null), plot_list)
  plot_list
}
```

```{r}
#| label: inspect-pairs-3d
#| fig-cap: "3D inspection of all trees by pair status."

# ── Shared-plane-aware pair inspection – 3-D stem slice extractor ────────────
# When pair_planes is available (second_run) each tree's window is anchored to
# its pair's shared_plane; trees not found in pair_planes fall back to per-tree
# relative Z so the function is safe for both run modes.
extract_inspect_slice_v2 <- function(las, tree_ids, z_min, z_max,
                                     pair_planes_df  = NULL,
                                     tid_col         = "TreeID_1",
                                     plane_col       = "shared_plane") {
  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(tree_ids, function(tid) {
    df <- as.data.frame(las@data[, c("X", "Y", "Z", "TreeID")]) |>
      dplyr::filter(TreeID == tid)
    if (nrow(df) == 0L) return(NULL)

    sp <- NULL
    if (!is.null(pair_planes_df)) {
      row <- pair_planes_df[pair_planes_df[[tid_col]] == tid, ]
      if (nrow(row) > 0L) sp <- row[[plane_col]][1L]
    }

    if (!is.null(sp)) {
      df |> dplyr::filter(Z >= sp + z_min, Z <= sp + z_max)
    } else {
      df |>
        dplyr::mutate(Z_rel = Z - min(Z)) |>
        dplyr::filter(Z_rel >= z_min, Z_rel <= z_max)
    }
  }))
}

if (params$make_plots) {

  inspect_z_min   <- 1
  inspect_z_max   <- 3
  points_per_tree <- 1000
  ring_n_pts      <- 60L

  # ── All TreeIDs present in each cloud ──────────────────────────────────────
  all_tids_1 <- unique(las_1@data$TreeID[!is.na(las_1@data$TreeID) & las_1@data$TreeID != 0L])
  all_tids_2 <- unique(las_2@data$TreeID[!is.na(las_2@data$TreeID) & las_2@data$TreeID != 0L])

  kept_tids_1 <- pairs_stage1$TreeID_1
  kept_tids_2 <- pairs_stage1$TreeID_2
  lost_tids_1 <- setdiff(all_tids_1, kept_tids_1)
  lost_tids_2 <- setdiff(all_tids_2, kept_tids_2)

  # Plane lookup tables – NULL when not in second_run mode
  pp1 <- if (second_run && exists("pair_planes"))
    pair_planes[, c("TreeID_1", "shared_plane")] else NULL
  pp2 <- if (second_run && exists("pair_planes"))
    pair_planes[, c("TreeID_2", "shared_plane")] else NULL

  # ── Extract and label points ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  extract_group <- function(las, tids, z_min, z_max, n, group_label,
                            pair_planes_df = NULL, tid_col = "TreeID_1") {
    if (length(tids) == 0L) return(NULL)
    extract_inspect_slice_v2(las, tids, z_min, z_max,
                             pair_planes_df = pair_planes_df,
                             tid_col        = tid_col) |>
      dplyr::group_by(TreeID) |>
      dplyr::slice_sample(n = n) |>
      dplyr::ungroup() |>
      dplyr::mutate(group = group_label)
  }

  pts_1_kept <- extract_group(las_1, kept_tids_1, inspect_z_min, inspect_z_max,
                              points_per_tree, "las_1 kept",
                              pair_planes_df = pp1, tid_col = "TreeID_1")
  pts_1_lost <- extract_group(las_1, lost_tids_1, inspect_z_min, inspect_z_max,
                              points_per_tree, "las_1 non-kept")   # no shared plane for unmatched
  pts_2_kept <- extract_group(las_2, kept_tids_2, inspect_z_min, inspect_z_max,
                              points_per_tree, "las_2 kept",
                              pair_planes_df = pp2, tid_col = "TreeID_2")
  pts_2_lost <- extract_group(las_2, lost_tids_2, inspect_z_min, inspect_z_max,
                              points_per_tree, "las_2 non-kept")   # no shared plane for unmatched

  all_pts <- dplyr::bind_rows(pts_1_kept, pts_1_lost, pts_2_kept, pts_2_lost)
  if (nrow(all_pts) == 0L) {
    cat("No points to plot.\n")
  } else {

    cx <- mean(all_pts$X, na.rm = TRUE)
    cy <- mean(all_pts$Y, na.rm = TRUE)
    all_pts <- all_pts |> dplyr::mutate(X_local = X - cx, Y_local = Y - cy)

    group_colours <- c(
      "las_1 kept"     = COL_1,
      "las_1 non-kept" = scales::alpha(COL_1, 0.35),
      "las_2 kept"     = COL_2,
      "las_2 non-kept" = scales::alpha(COL_2, 0.35)
    )
    group_opacity <- c(
      "las_1 kept"     = 0.7,
      "las_1 non-kept" = 0.3,
      "las_2 kept"     = 0.7,
      "las_2 non-kept" = 0.3
    )

    build_group_rings <- function(las, tids, valid_list, cx, cy, n) {
      dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(tids, function(tid) {
        r <- build_pair_rings(valid_list, tid, las, n = n)
        if (is.null(r) || nrow(r) == 0L) return(NULL)
        r |> dplyr::mutate(X_local = X - cx, Y_local = Y - cy, TreeID = tid)
      }))
    }

    rings_1_kept <- build_group_rings(las_1, kept_tids_1, ellipses_zt_1_valid_all, cx, cy, ring_n_pts)
    rings_2_kept <- build_group_rings(las_2, kept_tids_2, ellipses_zt_2_valid_all, cx, cy, ring_n_pts)

    group_order <- c("las_1 kept", "las_1 non-kept", "las_2 kept", "las_2 non-kept")
    p <- plot_ly()

    for (grp in group_order) {

      if (nrow(d) == 0L) next

        name        = grp, legendgroup = grp,
        marker      = list(size    = 2,
                           color   = group_colours[[grp]],
                           opacity = group_opacity[[grp]]),
        text        = ~paste0("TreeID: ", TreeID, "<br>", grp),
        hoverinfo   = "text"
      )
    }

    if (!is.null(rings_1_kept) && nrow(rings_1_kept) > 0L) {
      p <- p |> add_trace(

        x = ~X_local, y = ~Y_local, z = ~Z,
        type        = "scatter3d", mode = "lines",
        name        = "las_1 kept", legendgroup = "las_1 kept",
        showlegend  = FALSE,
        line        = list(color = COL_1, width = 2),
        hoverinfo   = "none", inherit = FALSE
      )

    if (!is.null(rings_2_kept) && nrow(rings_2_kept) > 0L) {
      p <- p |> add_trace(

        x = ~X_local, y = ~Y_local, z = ~Z,

    p |> layout(

        zaxis = list(title = "Z (m)"),
        aspectmode = "data"
      ),
      legend = list(title = list(text = "Group"))
    )
  }
```

## 1.6 Slice Fate Track


One row per fitted slice, per stem, carrying the verdict the pipeline reached
and the geometry it reached it on. This is the record the checkpoint stores, so
the kept/removed breakdown survives a bare load without re-running any cleaning.

Verdicts, in the order the pipeline applies them:

| status | meaning |
|---|---|
| `kept` | survived pass 1 and pass 2 |
| `mad1` | removed by the pass-1 MAD stage – never a refit target |
| `consensus1` | removed by pass-1 consensus, and the masked refit did not recover it |
| `consensus2` | reached pass 2, removed by pass-2 consensus |
| `mad2` | reached pass 2, removed by pass-2 MAD |

Slices that were never fitted carry no verdict and are left out of the ledger;
they are counted in the per-stem summary as `n_unfitted`.

```{r}
#| label: params-slice-fate-ledger
#| code-summary: "Parameters - Per-stem ledger of kept / MAD-removed / consensus-removed slices"


# Reads the stored results only – nothing is recomputed here, so the ledger and
# the fig-refit-clean2-slice-status figure always agree.
#
# Source frames:
#   refit_flagged_*      pass-1 flags + refit geometry and refit_status
#   clean2_results_*_all pass-2 flags, only for slices that reached pass 2
# If the refit was skipped, the pass-1 flagged frames are used on their own and
# every consensus removal lands in "consensus1".

.fate_eps <- 1e-6

.par_apply("params-slice-fate-ledger")
```

```{r}
#| label: slice-fate-ledger
#| code-summary: "Per-stem ledger of kept / MAD-removed / consensus-removed slices"

.fate_has <- function(d, nm) !is.null(d) && nm %in% names(d)
.fate_is  <- function(d, nm, i) .fate_has(d, nm) && isTRUE(d[[nm]][i])

.fate_axis <- function(d, i) {
  ax <- c(if (.fate_is(d, "mad_minor_out", i)) "minor",
          if (.fate_is(d, "mad_major_out", i)) "major")
  if (length(ax) == 0L) NA_character_ else paste(ax, collapse = "+")
}

# ── One stem ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
.slice_fate_one <- function(base, c2, have_pass2) {

  if (is.null(base) || nrow(base) == 0L) return(NULL)
  base <- as.data.frame(base)
  c2   <- if (is.null(c2) || nrow(c2) == 0L) NULL else as.data.frame(c2)

  n      <- nrow(base)
  status <- rep(NA_character_, n)
  axis   <- rep(NA_character_, n)

  for (i in seq_len(n)) {

    if (.fate_is(base, "unfitted", i)) next        # never fitted -> no verdict

    # Pass-1 MAD outranks everything: these slices were never refit targets.
    if (.fate_is(base, "mad_minor_out", i) || .fate_is(base, "mad_major_out", i)) {
      status[i] <- "mad1"
      axis[i]   <- .fate_axis(base, i)
      next
    }

    if (!have_pass2) {
      status[i] <- if (.fate_is(base, "no_consensus", i)) "consensus1" else "kept"
      next
    }

    hit <- if (is.null(c2)) integer(0) else
             which(abs(c2$slice_z - base$slice_z[i]) <= .fate_eps)

    # Absent from the pass-2 frame = pass-1 consensus removal whose refit
    # failed or was never attempted. Permanently gone.
    if (length(hit) != 1L) { status[i] <- "consensus1"; next }

    if (.fate_is(c2, "no_consensus", hit)) { status[i] <- "consensus2"; next }

    if (.fate_is(c2, "mad_minor_out", hit) || .fate_is(c2, "mad_major_out", hit)) {
      status[i] <- "mad2"
      axis[i]   <- .fate_axis(c2, hit)
      next
    }

    status[i] <- "kept"
  }

  keep <- !is.na(status)
  if (!any(keep)) return(NULL)

  z0 <- min(base$slice_z, na.rm = TRUE)
  pick <- function(nm, default) if (.fate_has(base, nm)) base[[nm]] else default

  out <- data.frame(
    slice_z      = base$slice_z,
    dz           = base$slice_z - z0,
    center_x     = pick("center_x",  NA_real_),
    center_y     = pick("center_y",  NA_real_),
    semi_a       = pick("semi_a",    NA_real_),
    semi_b       = pick("semi_b",    NA_real_),
    angle_deg    = pick("angle_deg", NA_real_),
    minor_len    = pick("minor_len", NA_real_),
    major_len    = pick("major_len", NA_real_),
    ell_ecc      = pick("ell_ecc",   NA_real_),
    n_agreeing   = pick("n_agreeing", NA_integer_),
    refit        = pick("refit",       FALSE),
    refit_status = pick("refit_status", NA_character_),
    status       = status,
    mad_axis     = axis,
    kept         = status == "kept",
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  if (.fate_has(base, "n_cand_pts")) out$n_cand_pts <- base$n_cand_pts
  if (.fate_has(base, "inlier_ids")) out$n_inliers  <- lengths(base$inlier_ids)

  out[keep, , drop = FALSE]
}

# ── One epoch ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
.slice_fate_frame <- function(flagged_list, clean2_result, epoch_label) {

  if (is.null(flagged_list) || length(flagged_list) == 0L) return(NULL)
  have_pass2 <- !is.null(clean2_result)

  parts <- lapply(names(flagged_list), function(tid) {
    c2 <- if (have_pass2) clean2_result[[tid]]$flagged else NULL
    d  <- .slice_fate_one(flagged_list[[tid]], c2, have_pass2)
    if (is.null(d) || nrow(d) == 0L) return(NULL)
    cbind(epoch = epoch_label, TreeID = tid, d, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  })

  out <- do.call(rbind, Filter(Negate(is.null), parts))
  if (is.null(out) || nrow(out) == 0L) return(NULL)

  out$h <- out$dz + (if (is.null(ransac_slice_bot)) 0 else ransac_slice_bot) +
           ransac_slice_width / 2

  rownames(out) <- NULL
  out[order(out$TreeID, out$slice_z), , drop = FALSE]
}

# ── Per-stem counts ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
.slice_fate_summary <- function(fates, flagged_list, epoch_label) {

  if (is.null(fates) || nrow(fates) == 0L) return(NULL)

  n_of <- function(d, v) sum(d$status == v, na.rm = TRUE)

  tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(fates, fates$TreeID), function(d) {
    tid  <- d$TreeID[1]
    base <- if (!is.null(flagged_list)) flagged_list[[tid]] else NULL
    data.frame(
      epoch        = epoch_label,
      TreeID       = tid,
      n_slices     = if (is.null(base)) nrow(d) else nrow(base),
      n_unfitted   = if (.fate_has(base, "unfitted")) sum(base$unfitted, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_integer_,
      n_fitted     = nrow(d),
      n_kept       = n_of(d, "kept"),
      n_mad1       = n_of(d, "mad1"),
      n_consensus1 = n_of(d, "consensus1"),
      n_consensus2 = n_of(d, "consensus2"),
      n_mad2       = n_of(d, "mad2"),
      n_refit_ok   = sum(d$refit %in% TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
      z_min_kept   = if (any(d$kept)) min(d$slice_z[d$kept]) else NA_real_,
      z_max_kept   = if (any(d$kept)) max(d$slice_z[d$kept]) else NA_real_,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }))

  tab$pct_kept <- round(100 * tab$n_kept / pmax(1L, tab$n_fitted), 1)
  rownames(tab) <- NULL
  tab
}

.print_fate_summary <- function(tab, label) {
  if (is.null(tab) || nrow(tab) == 0L) {
    cat(sprintf("\n[%s] Slice fate ledger: no fitted slices.\n", label))
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  cat(sprintf("\n[%s] Slice fate ledger - %d stem(s)\n", label, nrow(tab)))
  print(tab[, c("TreeID", "n_fitted", "n_kept", "n_mad1", "n_consensus1",
                "n_consensus2", "n_mad2", "n_refit_ok", "pct_kept")],
        row.names = FALSE)
  cat(sprintf(
    "  TOTAL: %d fitted -> %d kept (%.1f%%) | removed: %d mad1, %d consensus1, %d consensus2, %d mad2\n",
    sum(tab$n_fitted), sum(tab$n_kept),
    100 * sum(tab$n_kept) / max(1L, sum(tab$n_fitted)),
    sum(tab$n_mad1), sum(tab$n_consensus1), sum(tab$n_consensus2), sum(tab$n_mad2)))
  invisible(tab)
}

# ── Build ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Prefer the refit frames (they carry the refit geometry and status); fall back
# to the pass-1 flagged frames when the refit was skipped.
.fate_base_1 <- if (exists("refit_flagged_1") && !is.null(refit_flagged_1)) {
  refit_flagged_1
} else if (exists("clean_results_1_all") && !is.null(clean_results_1_all)) {
  lapply(clean_results_1_all, `[[`, "flagged")
} else NULL

.fate_base_2 <- if (exists("refit_flagged_2") && !is.null(refit_flagged_2)) {
  refit_flagged_2
} else if (exists("clean_results_2_all") && !is.null(clean_results_2_all)) {
  lapply(clean_results_2_all, `[[`, "flagged")
} else NULL

if (is.null(.fate_base_1) && is.null(.fate_base_2))
  stop("No cleaning results found - run the ransac-ellipse-clean chunk first.")

.fate_c2_1 <- if (exists("clean2_results_1_all")) clean2_results_1_all else NULL
.fate_c2_2 <- if (exists("clean2_results_2_all")) clean2_results_2_all else NULL

slice_fates_1 <- .slice_fate_frame(.fate_base_1, .fate_c2_1, "las_1")
slice_fates_2 <- .slice_fate_frame(.fate_base_2, .fate_c2_2, "las_2")

slice_fate_summary_1 <- .slice_fate_summary(slice_fates_1, .fate_base_1, "las_1")
slice_fate_summary_2 <- .slice_fate_summary(slice_fates_2, .fate_base_2, "las_2")

.print_fate_summary(slice_fate_summary_1, "las_1")
.print_fate_summary(slice_fate_summary_2, "las_2")

# Convenience splits, in case a downstream chunk wants one category directly.
# Column-safe: if one epoch carries a diagnostic column the other does not
# (n_inliers, n_cand_pts), the combined frame keeps only the shared columns.
.fate_rbind <- function(a, b) {
  if (is.null(a)) return(b)
  if (is.null(b)) return(a)
  keep <- intersect(names(a), names(b))
  rbind(a[, keep, drop = FALSE], b[, keep, drop = FALSE])
}

slice_fates_all <- .fate_rbind(slice_fates_1, slice_fates_2)
if (is.null(slice_fates_all)) {
  slice_fates_kept    <- NULL
  slice_fates_removed <- NULL
  cat("\nLedger: no fitted slices in either epoch.\n")
} else {
  slice_fates_kept    <- slice_fates_all[slice_fates_all$status == "kept", , drop = FALSE]
  slice_fates_removed <- slice_fates_all[slice_fates_all$status != "kept", , drop = FALSE]
  cat(sprintf("\nLedger: %d fitted slice(s) across both epochs | %d kept | %d removed\n",
              nrow(slice_fates_all), nrow(slice_fates_kept), nrow(slice_fates_removed)))
}
```



## Save/Load – Stage 1


!Warning!: `stage1_load <- TRUE` overwrites the current session objects. Saving
is always safe: an existing target file is never overwritten, a free
`_001`/`_002`/... name is used instead.

Saving **errors** if any required object is missing (so a checkpoint is never
written half-complete) and **warns** for missing optional/diagnostic objects.
Loading only ever **warns** – for requested objects absent from the file, and
for objects in the file this stage did not ask for.

The checkpoint deliberately excludes all point-cloud data (`las_1`, `las_2`,
`xyz_1`, `xyz_2`, `las_1_rot`, ...) and every object created by a
*visualisation* chunk. It does include everything the visualisation chunks
*consume*, so the Stage 1 figures can be regenerated after a bare load.

```{r}
#| label: params-save-load_Stage1
#| code-summary: "Parameters - Save or load the complete Stage 1 object set"


# ── Stage 1 checkpoint path ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
stage1_rds_path <- "C:/Users/ascsh/Documents/1_Artemis/11_PaqLab/115_TreeTimeAlign/SaveLoad/Stage1_BOS_F1_aii_man.rds"

# ── Toggles ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
stage1_save <- TRUE
stage1_load <- FALSE

.par_apply("params-save-load_Stage1")
```

```{r}
#| label: save-load_Stage1
#| code-summary: "Save or load the complete Stage 1 object set"

# A batch decides these itself, whatever they are left set to above. Both are
# read a few lines below, in this same chunk, so the driver's overrides land
# too late to reach them - and a stage left switched to LOAD after an
# interactive session would otherwise make a batch write no checkpoint at all
# and say nothing about it. Saving is what a batch is for; loading is a no-op
# in one, since every stage runs in the same session.
if (.in_batch()) { stage1_save <- TRUE; stage1_load <- FALSE }

# Path is set in this chunk (stage1_rds_path).

# The checkpoint carries ONLY objects a later stage reads. Stage-1-internal
# products - the raw fit/clean result lists, per-run diagnostic counts, the CSV
# and RANSAC-budget input parameters, the cleaning toggles - are rebuilt every
# time Stage 1 runs and are consumed nowhere downstream, so they are not saved.
.stage1_required <- c(
  # -- File paths + fit provenance (reloaded / reported by Stage 3) --
  "las_1_path",
  "las_2_path",
  "ransac_ellipse_script",
  "second_run",
  "ransac_seed",
  "ransac_track_history",
  # -- Slice band (Stage 2 axis-window logic reads bot/top) --------
  "ransac_slice_bot",
  "ransac_slice_top",
  # -- Cloud summary + pivot ---------------------------------------
  "treeids_1",
  "treeids_2",
  "pivot1",
  "pivot1_mode",
  "run_counts",
  # -- Rough vertical alignment (Stage 1A): rotation applied to las_1 --
  "run_rough_alignment",
  "R_align_1",
  "align_pivot_1",
  "forest_axis_vec_1",
  "align_upside_down",
  "align_ud_confident",
  # Orientation verdict (1A.2) + bounding-box sideways correction (1A.0).
  # Always defined, so kept required. R_align_1 already folds R_sideways_pre in;
  # the three matrices are retained for auditing the composition.
  "align_sideways",
  "align_orientation",
  "align_sideways_rotated",
  "align_sw_probed",
  "R_sideways_yaw",
  "R_sideways_90",
  "R_sideways_pre",
  # Every leg, the composition, the shared pivot and the verified round-trip
  # error, in one auditable object. R_residual is the leg 1A.4 actually applied.
  "R_residual",
  "align_rotations",
  "align_check_max_err",
  # -- Step 1.1 RANSAC fit products (Stage 2 ellipse geometry) -----
  "fp",
  "ellipses_zt_1_all",
  "ellipses_zt_2_all",
  # -- Step 1.2 cleaning: MAD multipliers + params record + valid sets
  "mad_minor_mult",
  "mad_major_mult",
  "cp",
  "ellipses_zt_1_valid_all",
  "ellipses_zt_2_valid_all",
  # -- Temporal pairing --------------------------------------------
  "pairs_stage1"
)

.stage1_optional <- c(
  # -- Post-refit sets (Stage 2 loader's ellipse-set inventory) ----
  "ellipses_zt_1_refit_all",
  "ellipses_zt_2_refit_all",
  # -- Second-pass valid sets + slice-fate ledger (read by Stage 2 figures) --
  "ellipses_zt_1_valid2_all",
  "ellipses_zt_2_valid2_all",
  "slice_fates_1",
  "slice_fates_2",
  "slice_fates_all",
  "slice_fate_summary_1",
  "slice_fate_summary_2",
  # -- Stage 1A diagnostics ----------------------------------------
  "align_slope_df",
  # -- Stage 1A.1b density probe: the four per-slice figures per epoch, the
  # per-tree breakdown, the probe geometry they were measured at, and the
  # slice width they recommended (NULL when no threshold was set). Optional,
  # so a run with run_density_probe = FALSE still saves cleanly.
  "density_stats",
  "density_stats_by_tree",
  "density_probe_width",
  "density_probe_step",
  "density_regime",
  "density_scarcity",
  "density_centre_scatter",
  "density_max_frac_centre",
  "density_max_frac_minor",
  "density_max_frac_major",
  "density_apply_regime",
  "density_slice_width_reco",
  "density_distance_threshold_reco",
  # Sideways detection (1A.0): the per-tree bounding boxes the verdict was read
  # from, and the verdict itself. align_bbox_1 is the PROBED frame's boxes when
  # a 45 deg probe was kept.
  "align_bbox_1",
  "align_sw_verdict"
)

if (stage1_save) {
  .stage_save(stage1_rds_path, .stage1_required, .stage1_optional, label = "Stage 1")
}

if (stage1_load) {
  .stage_load(stage1_rds_path, .stage1_required, .stage1_optional, label = "Stage 1")
  cat(sprintf("\nStage 1 restored: %d pair(s) | %d las_1 trees | %d las_2 trees\n",
              nrow(pairs_stage1), length(treeids_1), length(treeids_2)))
  .report_pivot1()
}
```


### Export Pairs CSV


```{r}
#| label: params-export-pairs-csv
#| code-summary: "Parameters - Export final temporal pairs to a non-overwriting CSV"


export_pairs <- TRUE

.par_apply("params-export-pairs-csv")
```

```{r}
#| label: export-pairs-csv
#| code-summary: "Export final temporal pairs to a non-overwriting CSV"

if (export_pairs) {
  
# ── Parameters ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
.pairs_out_dir  <- "C:/Users/Waldagil/Documents/AaronMThesis/Data_Sheets/Temporal_Pairs"
.pairs_basename <- "F1125"

# A batch supplies its own destination and names the file after the sample.
# This has to be read HERE rather than pushed in by the driver: the chunk
# assigns the path and writes the file in one go, so an override applied after
# the chunk arrives too late to matter. The default above is one machine's
# absolute path, which is exactly the kind of thing a batch must not inherit.
if (.in_batch()) {
  .pairs_out_dir  <- .batch_opt(".batch_pairs_dir", .pairs_out_dir)
  .pairs_basename <- .batch_opt(".batch_sample",    .pairs_basename)
}

# ── Non-overwriting write ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Interactive runs never overwrite: a second run parks itself at _1, _2, and so
# on. In a batch the sample name already makes the path unique, and a suffixed
# duplicate would just be a file nobody can trace back to a run, so the sample's
# own file is overwritten instead.
.pairs_make_path <- function(dir, base, suffix = "") {
  file.path(dir, paste0(base, suffix, ".csv"))
}
.pairs_out_path <- .pairs_make_path(.pairs_out_dir, .pairs_basename)
if (!.in_batch() && file.exists(.pairs_out_path)) {
  .i <- 1L
  while (file.exists(.pairs_make_path(.pairs_out_dir, .pairs_basename, paste0("_", .i)))) .i <- .i + 1L
  .pairs_out_path <- .pairs_make_path(.pairs_out_dir, .pairs_basename, paste0("_", .i))
}

# Nothing downstream reads this file - it is a record for the user - so in a
# batch a failed write is reported and the pair carries on. By hand it still
# errors, where the person who asked for the export is there to see it.
.pairs_write <- function() {
  dir.create(.pairs_out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  write.csv(pairs_stage1[, c("TreeID_1", "TreeID_2")], .pairs_out_path, row.names = FALSE)
  message("Saved: ", .pairs_out_path)
}
if (.in_batch()) {
  tryCatch(.pairs_write(),
           error = function(e)
             cat(sprintf("[pairs export] SKIPPED - could not write %s: %s\n",
                         .pairs_out_path, conditionMessage(e))))
} else {
  .pairs_write()
}

}
```
